This notebook reproduces every figure, table and in-text number of the
manuscript (MS) and its Supplementary Materials (SM) from the datasets shipped
in this repository. The closing section asserts each published value with
`stopifnot()`: the notebook does not knit if any number drifts. Three SM
figures (S1, S11, S12) are static diagrams and are embedded rather than
recomputed here. The control-Earth figures are drawn from the banked outputs in
`control_earth/datasets/output/`, and every number behind them is asserted from
the same tables.

\newpage

# Setup

Packages, helper functions and data paths. `HEADLINE_WINDOW = "w_full"` selects the full-mission window used throughout the paper.

```{r prelim, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide", cache.extra=lapply(list.files(here::here("functions"), pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE), file.mtime)}

# PRELIMINARY ##################################################################

# Load packages ----------------------------------------------------------------

if (!requireNamespace("sensobol", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("sensobol")
sensobol::load_packages(c("here", "data.table", "ncdf4", "abind",
                            "ggplot2", "cowplot", "scales", "ggrepel",
                            "viridisLite", "RColorBrewer", "maps",
                            "benchmarkme"))

# Source all .R files in the "functions" folder -------------------------------

r_functions <- list.files(path = here::here("functions"),
                          pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)
invisible(lapply(r_functions, source))

## ---- Headline analysis window -------------------------------------------
## "w_full" -> full mission 2002-04..2025-12, 272 months (headline;
## tier_a_full[_73]/).
HEADLINE_WINDOW <- "w_full"
.tier_a_subdir     <- if (HEADLINE_WINDOW == "w_full") "tier_a_full_73" else "tier_a"
.tier_a_276_subdir <- if (HEADLINE_WINDOW == "w_full") "tier_a_full"    else "tier_a_276"
tier_a_dir <- here::here("datasets", "output", .tier_a_subdir)
cohort_csv <- here::here("datasets", "jasechko_2024", "cohort_50K_n73.csv")
climate_csv <- here::here("datasets", "jasechko_2024",
                            "cohort_climate_zones.csv")

output_dir <- here::here("datasets", "output")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# The pre-processing choice space

Panel data for the Indo-Gangetic Plain example cell; the recipe-tree panel is the static input `figures/preprocessing_choice_space.pdf`.

```{r load-section1, dependson="prelim", cache.extra=file.mtime(list.files(here::here("datasets", "output", "section1"), full.names = TRUE))}

# LOAD SECTION-1 REDUCED ARTEFACTS ############################################

# Section 1 illustrates the 1,920-recipe preprocessing spread on one IGP grid
# cell -- the only section that depends on the per-recipe cube.

section1_dir <- here::here("datasets", "output", "section1")

# Example cell: EWH series over the full GRACE+GRACE-FO record for each
# of the 1,920 recipes (long form).
flip_ts <- data.table::fread(
  file.path(section1_dir, "fig1_flip_timeseries.csv"))
flip_ts[, date := as.Date(date)]

recipe_fam <- data.table::fread(
  file.path(section1_dir, "fig1_recipe_families.csv"))

# Section 2's global-counts chunk reads Section 1's data window from `recipes`.
recipes <- list(times = as.Date(sort(unique(flip_ts$date))))

cat("Section-1 artefacts:", data.table::uniqueN(recipe_fam$recipe),
    "recipes,", length(recipes$times), "GRACE+GRACE-FO months.\n")
```

```{r fig-paper-1-flip, dependson="load-section1", cache.extra=file.mtime(here::here("figures","preprocessing_choice_space.pdf")), fig.width=5.5, fig.height=2.9}

# FIG 1: ONE CELL, 1,920 RECIPES, COLOURED BY SIGN ############################

recipe_sign <- recipe_fam[, .(recipe,
  sign_lab = factor(ifelse(flip_trend_cm_yr >= 0, "gaining", "depleting"),
                    levels = c("depleting", "gaining")))]
sign_pal <- c(depleting = "#8b3a3a", gaining = "#3a7a3a")

# Panel (b): time-series spaghetti coloured by recipe sign --------------------
traces_flip <- flip_ts[!is.na(ewh_cm), .(time = date, recipe, value = ewh_cm)]
traces_flip <- merge(traces_flip, recipe_sign, by = "recipe")
data.table::setorder(traces_flip, recipe, time)
traces_flip[, gap_days := c(0, diff(as.numeric(time))), by = recipe]
traces_flip[, segment := cumsum(gap_days > 90), by = recipe]
traces_flip[, group_id := paste0(recipe, "_", segment)]

flip_env <- flip_ts[, .(median = stats::median(ewh_cm, na.rm = TRUE),
                        q25 = stats::quantile(ewh_cm, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
                        q75 = stats::quantile(ewh_cm, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
                    by = .(time = date)]
flip_env <- flip_env[is.finite(median)]
data.table::setorder(flip_env, time)
flip_env[, gap_days := c(0, diff(as.numeric(time)))]
flip_env[, segment := cumsum(gap_days > 90)]

# Y trim: central 99% of recipe-month values (a few JPL/DDK8 recipes spike to
# about -250 / +120 cm on degraded-arc months).
yf_lo <- stats::quantile(traces_flip$value, 0.005, na.rm = TRUE)
yf_hi <- stats::quantile(traces_flip$value, 0.995, na.rm = TRUE)
yf_pad <- 0.05 * (yf_hi - yf_lo)

p_trace_flip <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = traces_flip[sign_lab == "gaining"],
            aes(x = time, y = value, group = group_id),
            colour = sign_pal[["gaining"]], alpha = 0.10, linewidth = 0.01) +
  geom_line(data = traces_flip[sign_lab == "depleting"],
            aes(x = time, y = value, group = group_id),
            colour = sign_pal[["depleting"]], alpha = 0.10, linewidth = 0.01) +
  geom_ribbon(data = flip_env,
              aes(x = time, ymin = q25, ymax = q75, group = segment),
              fill = "#3a78c2", alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_line(data = flip_env,
            aes(x = time, y = median, group = segment),
            colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(yf_lo - yf_pad, yf_hi + yf_pad)) +
  labs(x = "year", y = "EWH (cm)") +
  theme_AP()

slopes_flip <- data.table::data.table(trend = recipe_fam$flip_trend_cm_yr)
slopes_flip[, sign_lab := factor(ifelse(trend >= 0, "gaining", "depleting"),
                                 levels = c("depleting", "gaining"))]
medf <- stats::median(slopes_flip$trend, na.rm = TRUE)
q25f <- stats::quantile(slopes_flip$trend, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
q75f <- stats::quantile(slopes_flip$trend, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
rngf <- range(slopes_flip$trend, na.rm = TRUE)
padf <- 0.04 * diff(rngf)

p_dist_flip <- ggplot(slopes_flip, aes(x = 0, y = trend)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = sign_lab), height = 0, width = 0.32, alpha = 0.20,
              size = 0.7, shape = 16) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -0.55, xmax = 0.55, ymin = q25f, ymax = q75f,
           fill = "#3a78c2", alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = medf, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = sign_pal, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), breaks = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(rngf[1] - padf, rngf[2] + padf)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "recipe trend (cm/yr)") +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank())

# Panel (a): conceptual diagram of preprocessing choice-space ----------------

# Pre-compiled TikZ PDF (figures/preprocessing_choice_space.tex -> .pdf).
choice_space_pdf <- here::here("figures", "preprocessing_choice_space.pdf")
if (file.exists(choice_space_pdf)) {
  if (!requireNamespace("magick", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("magick")
  p_concept <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_image(magick::image_read_pdf(choice_space_pdf, density = 300))
} else {
  p_concept <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_label(
      paste0("(compile figures/preprocessing_choice_space.tex ",
              "to populate panel (a))"),
      size = 10, colour = "grey50")
}

# Compose: (a) concept on top; (b) + (c) on the bottom row --------------------
row_bottom_flip <- cowplot::plot_grid(p_trace_flip, p_dist_flip, ncol = 2,
                                      rel_widths = c(0.8, 0.2),
                                      labels = c("b", "c"),
                                      align = "h", axis = "tb")
cowplot::plot_grid(p_concept, row_bottom_flip, ncol = 1,
                   rel_heights = c(0.34, 0.66), labels = c("a", ""))
```

# The detectability boundary

Dominance gradient, the $R=1$ boundary (seed 71, 2,000 bootstrap resamples) and the 95\%-sign-agreement boundary.

```{r global-gradient-stats, dependson="load-tier-a"}

# GRADIENT REGRESSION + R DISTRIBUTION ########################################

# Spearman rho(|GRACE recipe-median trend|, dominance R) with bootstrap 95% CI
ok <- is.finite(gradient_data$abs_GRACE_trend) &
        is.finite(gradient_data$dominance_R)
x_ok <- gradient_data$abs_GRACE_trend[ok]
y_ok <- gradient_data$dominance_R[ok]

rho_obs <- stats::cor(x_ok, y_ok, method = "spearman")
set.seed(43L)
n_boot <- 2000L
rho_boot <- replicate(n_boot, {
  idx <- sample.int(length(x_ok), replace = TRUE)
  suppressWarnings(stats::cor(x_ok[idx], y_ok[idx], method = "spearman"))
})
ci <- stats::quantile(rho_boot, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

# Cross-modality with Jasechko's own Theil-Sen well trend
rho_jas <- stats::cor(abs(gradient_data$abs_trend_m_yr[ok]),
                        gradient_data$dominance_R[ok],
                        method = "spearman")
rho_cross <- stats::cor(gradient_data$abs_GRACE_trend[ok],
                          abs(gradient_data$abs_trend_m_yr[ok]),
                          method = "spearman")

cat("\n=== Gradient (Pillar 1) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  Spearman rho(|GRACE trend|, R) = %+.3f  95%% CI [%+.3f, %+.3f]  n=%d\n",
            rho_obs, ci[1L], ci[2L], length(x_ok)))
cat(sprintf("  Spearman rho(|Jasechko trend|, R) = %+.3f  (cross-modality)\n",
            rho_jas))
cat(sprintf("  Spearman rho(|GRACE|, |Jasechko|) = %+.3f  (aquifer-scale)\n",
            rho_cross))

# R distribution globally
R_all <- gradient_data$dominance_R[ok]
cat("\n=== Dominance R distribution (global) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  median R:        %.2f\n", stats::median(R_all)))
cat(sprintf("  IQR R:           [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
            stats::quantile(R_all, 0.25), stats::quantile(R_all, 0.75)))
cat(sprintf("  frac R < 0.5:    %.1f%% (%d of %d)\n",
            mean(R_all < 0.5) * 100,
            sum(R_all < 0.5), length(R_all)))
cat(sprintf("  frac R < 1.0:    %.1f%% (%d of %d)\n",
            mean(R_all < 1) * 100,
            sum(R_all < 1), length(R_all)))
cat(sprintf("  frac R > 1.0:    %.1f%% (%d of %d)\n",
            mean(R_all > 1) * 100,
            sum(R_all > 1), length(R_all)))

# By climate zone
cat("\n=== R distribution by climate zone ===\n")
zone_tab <- gradient_data[ok, .(
  n = .N,
  median_R = stats::median(dominance_R),
  frac_R_lt_0p5 = mean(dominance_R < 0.5),
  frac_R_lt_1 = mean(dominance_R < 1),
  frac_R_gt_1 = mean(dominance_R > 1)),
  by = climate_zone]
data.table::setorder(zone_tab, median_R)
print(zone_tab)
```

```{r boundary-ci, dependson="global-gradient-stats"}

# DETECTABILITY BOUNDARY -- bootstrap the R = 1 crossing ######################

r1_crossing_loess <- function(x, y, span = 0.75, grid_n = 400L) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y) & x > 0 & y > 0
  if (sum(ok) < 10L) return(NA_real_)
  lx <- log10(x[ok]); ly <- log10(y[ok])
  fit <- tryCatch(
    stats::loess(ly ~ lx, span = span,
                 control = stats::loess.control(surface = "direct")),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
  gx <- seq(min(lx), max(lx), length.out = grid_n)
  gy <- suppressWarnings(stats::predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(lx = gx)))
  s <- which(gy[-1] < 0 & gy[-length(gy)] >= 0)  # log10 R crosses 0 downward
  if (length(s) == 0L) return(NA_real_)
  i <- s[1L]
  10^(gx[i] + (0 - gy[i]) / (gy[i + 1L] - gy[i]) * (gx[i + 1L] - gx[i]))
}
r1_crossing_param <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y) & x > 0 & y > 0
  cf <- stats::coef(stats::lm(log10(y[ok]) ~ log10(x[ok])))
  10^(-cf[[1L]] / cf[[2L]])
}
boot_crossing <- function(x, y, fn, n_boot = 2000L, seed = 71L) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y) & x > 0 & y > 0
  x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
  obs <- fn(x, y)
  set.seed(seed)
  bs <- replicate(n_boot, {
    i <- sample.int(length(x), replace = TRUE)
    fn(x[i], y[i])
  })
  bs <- bs[is.finite(bs)]
  ci <- stats::quantile(bs, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  list(est = obs, lo = ci[[1L]], hi = ci[[2L]], n = length(x))
}

bnd_t1_loess <- boot_crossing(gradient_data$abs_GRACE_trend,
                              gradient_data$dominance_R, r1_crossing_loess)
bnd_t1_param <- boot_crossing(gradient_data$abs_GRACE_trend,
                              gradient_data$dominance_R, r1_crossing_param)

gd_276_bnd <- data.table::fread(
  here::here("datasets", "output", .tier_a_276_subdir, "gradient_data_276.csv"))
bnd_ta_loess <- boot_crossing(gd_276_bnd$abs_GRACE_trend,
                              gd_276_bnd$dominance_R, r1_crossing_loess)
bnd_ta_param <- boot_crossing(gd_276_bnd$abs_GRACE_trend,
                              gd_276_bnd$dominance_R, r1_crossing_param)

cat("=== Detectability boundary: |trend| at dominance R = 1 (cm/yr EWH) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  Tier 1   (n=%d)  loess     : %.2f  95%% CI [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
            bnd_t1_loess$n, bnd_t1_loess$est, bnd_t1_loess$lo, bnd_t1_loess$hi))
cat(sprintf("  Tier 1   (n=%d)  power-law : %.2f  95%% CI [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
            bnd_t1_param$n, bnd_t1_param$est, bnd_t1_param$lo, bnd_t1_param$hi))
cat(sprintf("  Tier 1+2 (n=%d) loess     : %.2f  95%% CI [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
            bnd_ta_loess$n, bnd_ta_loess$est, bnd_ta_loess$lo, bnd_ta_loess$hi))
cat(sprintf("  Tier 1+2 (n=%d) power-law : %.2f  95%% CI [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
            bnd_ta_param$n, bnd_ta_param$est, bnd_ta_param$lo, bnd_ta_param$hi))

```{r alt-metric-robustness, dependson=c("load-tier-a","global-gradient-stats")}

# ALTERNATIVE-METRIC ROBUSTNESS CHECK ##########################################
# Dominance R = IQR / |median| is the headline metric in Section 2 and the
# y-axis of Figure 2.

alt_dt <- per_recipe_trends[!is.na(trend_cm_yr),
  .(abs_med  = abs(stats::median(trend_cm_yr)),
    iqr      = stats::IQR(trend_cm_yr),
    sd_rec   = stats::sd(trend_cm_yr),
    n_pos    = sum(trend_cm_yr > 0),
    n_neg    = sum(trend_cm_yr < 0),
    n        = .N), by = Study_area]
alt_dt[, sign_agree := pmax(n_pos, n_neg) / n]
alt_dt[, dom_R := iqr / abs_med]

# Range diagnostics for R at small |median|
cat("=== R = IQR / |median| behaviour across Tier 1 ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  |median| range: %.4f -- %.3f cm/yr\n",
            min(alt_dt$abs_med, na.rm = TRUE),
            max(alt_dt$abs_med, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Dominance R range: %.2f -- %.1f\n",
            min(alt_dt$dom_R, na.rm = TRUE),
            max(alt_dt$dom_R, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Aquifers with |median| < 0.05 cm/yr (R risks blowing up): %d\n",
            sum(alt_dt$abs_med < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Aquifers with R > 10: %d   (extreme-R cases)\n",
            sum(alt_dt$dom_R > 10, na.rm = TRUE)))

# Spearman rho(|median|, alternative metric)
ok <- is.finite(alt_dt$abs_med) & is.finite(alt_dt$iqr)
cor_iqr  <- stats::cor(alt_dt$abs_med[ok], alt_dt$iqr[ok],   method = "spearman")
cor_sd   <- stats::cor(alt_dt$abs_med[ok], alt_dt$sd_rec[ok],method = "spearman")
cor_sa   <- stats::cor(alt_dt$abs_med[ok], alt_dt$sign_agree[ok],
                       method = "spearman")
cor_R    <- stats::cor(alt_dt$abs_med[ok], alt_dt$dom_R[ok], method = "spearman")
cat("\n=== Spearman rho(|median|, metric) -- gradient under alternative metrics ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  rho(|median|, sign_agreement) = %+.3f   (metric-independent; bounded)\n",
            cor_sa))
cat(sprintf("  rho(|median|, IQR alone)      = %+.3f   (no normalisation)\n", cor_iqr))
cat(sprintf("  rho(|median|, SD alone)       = %+.3f   (no normalisation)\n", cor_sd))
cat(sprintf("  rho(|median|, R = IQR/|med|)  = %+.3f   (headline metric)\n", cor_R))
cat("\nSign-agreement and R recover the gradient in opposite directions\n")
cat("(positive +0.88 vs negative -0.84) because high |median| <=> high\n")
cat("sign-agreement <=> low R; the relationship is the same phenomenon.\n")
cat("IQR alone is positively correlated with |median| (recipe spread\n")
cat("grows with signal, but slower), which is consistent with R < 1\n")
cat("dominating at the strong-signal end.\n")

```{r sa-boundary-ci, dependson=c("boundary-ci","alt-metric-robustness")}

# PARALLEL DETECTABILITY BOUNDARY -- sign-agreement = 0.95 ####################
# R = IQR / |median| blows up as |median| -> 0; the sign-agreement = 0.95
# crossing is a denominator-free alternative boundary metric.

# Helper: loess crossing of an upward-monotone curve (sign-agreement vs
# |median|).
sa_crossing_loess <- function(x, y, threshold = 0.95,
                              span = 0.75, grid_n = 400L) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y) & x > 0 & y >= 0.5 & y <= 1.0
  if (sum(ok) < 10L) return(NA_real_)
  lx <- log10(x[ok]); ly <- y[ok]
  fit <- tryCatch(
    stats::loess(ly ~ lx, span = span,
                 control = stats::loess.control(surface = "direct")),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
  gx <- seq(min(lx), max(lx), length.out = grid_n)
  gy <- suppressWarnings(stats::predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(lx = gx)))
  # Find the FIRST upward crossing of the threshold
  s <- which(gy[-1L] >= threshold & gy[-length(gy)] < threshold)
  if (length(s) == 0L) return(NA_real_)
  i <- s[1L]
  10^(gx[i] + (threshold - gy[i]) /
        (gy[i + 1L] - gy[i]) * (gx[i + 1L] - gx[i]))
}

# (1) W-FULL Tier-1 SA-0.95 boundary -----------------------------------------

# alt_dt (from alt-metric-robustness): one row per Tier-1 aquifer with
# abs_med and sign_agree.
bnd_t1_sa095_loess <- boot_crossing(
  alt_dt$abs_med, alt_dt$sign_agree,
  function(x, y) sa_crossing_loess(x, y, threshold = 0.95))

# (1b) W-FULL FULL-276 SA-0.95 boundary --------------------------------------
# The sign-agreement analogue of bnd_ta_loess (boundary-ci, the full-276
# R = 1 crossing), so the two-tier detectability gradient can carry the same
# pair of boundary bands.
.sp276_sa <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output",
              .tier_a_276_subdir, "sign_paradox_276.csv"))
.gd276_sa <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output",
              .tier_a_276_subdir, "gradient_data_276.csv"))
alt_dt_276 <- merge(.sp276_sa[, .(Study_area, sign_agree)],
                    .gd276_sa[, .(Study_area, abs_med = abs_GRACE_trend)],
                    by = "Study_area")
bnd_ta_sa095_loess <- boot_crossing(
  alt_dt_276$abs_med, alt_dt_276$sign_agree,
  function(x, y) sa_crossing_loess(x, y, threshold = 0.95))

# (2) W-FO POC Tier-1 boundaries (both metrics) ------------------------------

# Legacy GRACE-FO-only POC: 89-month window 2018-06 -> 2025-12, same
# 73-aquifer Tier-1 cohort.
wfo_grad <- data.table::fread(
  here::here("datasets", "output", "tier_a", "fig_gradient_data.csv"))
wfo_per_recipe <- data.table::fread(
  here::here("datasets", "output", "tier_a",
             "jasechko_per_recipe_trends.csv.gz"))

# Recompute sign-agreement per aquifer on the W-FO ensemble (the legacy
# fig_gradient_data.csv carries |median| and R but not sign_agree).
alt_dt_wfo <- wfo_per_recipe[!is.na(trend_cm_yr),
  .(abs_med = abs(stats::median(trend_cm_yr)),
    n_pos   = sum(trend_cm_yr > 0),
    n_neg   = sum(trend_cm_yr < 0),
    n       = .N), by = Study_area]
alt_dt_wfo[, sign_agree := pmax(n_pos, n_neg) / n]

bnd_wfo_R_loess <- boot_crossing(
  wfo_grad$abs_GRACE_trend, wfo_grad$dominance_R, r1_crossing_loess)
bnd_wfo_sa095_loess <- boot_crossing(
  alt_dt_wfo$abs_med, alt_dt_wfo$sign_agree,
  function(x, y) sa_crossing_loess(x, y, threshold = 0.95))

# Reporting ------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== Detectability boundary -- parallel evidence from two metrics ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  W-FULL Tier-1 (n=%d)  R = 1   loess: %.2f  95%% CI [%.2f, %.2f]  cm/yr EWH\n",
            bnd_t1_loess$n, bnd_t1_loess$est,
            bnd_t1_loess$lo, bnd_t1_loess$hi))
cat(sprintf("  W-FULL Tier-1 (n=%d)  SA= 0.95 loess: %.2f  95%% CI [%.2f, %.2f]  cm/yr EWH\n",
            bnd_t1_sa095_loess$n, bnd_t1_sa095_loess$est,
            bnd_t1_sa095_loess$lo, bnd_t1_sa095_loess$hi))
cat(sprintf("  W-FULL 1+2   (n=%d) SA= 0.95 loess: %.2f  95%% CI [%.2f, %.2f]  cm/yr EWH\n",
            bnd_ta_sa095_loess$n, bnd_ta_sa095_loess$est,
            bnd_ta_sa095_loess$lo, bnd_ta_sa095_loess$hi))
cat(sprintf("  W-FO   Tier-1 (n=%d)  R = 1   loess: %.2f  95%% CI [%.2f, %.2f]  cm/yr EWH\n",
            bnd_wfo_R_loess$n, bnd_wfo_R_loess$est,
            bnd_wfo_R_loess$lo, bnd_wfo_R_loess$hi))
cat(sprintf("  W-FO   Tier-1 (n=%d)  SA= 0.95 loess: %.2f  95%% CI [%.2f, %.2f]  cm/yr EWH\n",
            bnd_wfo_sa095_loess$n, bnd_wfo_sa095_loess$est,
            bnd_wfo_sa095_loess$lo, bnd_wfo_sa095_loess$hi))

# Window-conditioning diagnostic --------------------------------------------
# The boundary is window-conditional: W-FULL 0.35 vs W-FO ~0.50 differ
# by more than the CI half-width; the boundary is reported as
# window-conditional.
hw_wfull <- 0.5 * (bnd_t1_loess$hi - bnd_t1_loess$lo)
hw_wfo   <- 0.5 * (bnd_wfo_R_loess$hi - bnd_wfo_R_loess$lo)
shift_R  <- bnd_wfo_R_loess$est - bnd_t1_loess$est
shift_sa <- bnd_wfo_sa095_loess$est - bnd_t1_sa095_loess$est
ci_touch <- !((bnd_t1_loess$hi   < bnd_wfo_R_loess$lo) |
              (bnd_wfo_R_loess$hi < bnd_t1_loess$lo))
cat(sprintf("\n  R=1 CI half-widths:   W-FULL %.2f, W-FO %.2f cm/yr\n",
            hw_wfull, hw_wfo))
cat(sprintf("  R=1 boundary shift (W-FO minus W-FULL):     %+.2f cm/yr\n",
            shift_R))
cat(sprintf("  SA=0.95 boundary shift (W-FO minus W-FULL): %+.2f cm/yr\n",
            shift_sa))
cat(sprintf("  W-FULL vs W-FO R=1 CIs %s (W-FULL upper %.2f vs W-FO lower %.2f).\n",
            ifelse(ci_touch, "overlap", "are disjoint"),
            bnd_t1_loess$hi, bnd_wfo_R_loess$lo))
cat("  Both metrics shift in the same direction, so the boundary is\n")
cat("  window-conditional (longer record -> weaker trends clear the floor).\n")

# The sign paradox

```{r sign-paradox-stats, dependson="load-tier-a"}

# THE SIGN PARADOX ############################################################

# For each aquifer in the cohort, count how many of the 1,920 recipes return a
# positive vs negative trend.
sign_paradox <- per_recipe_trends[!is.na(trend_cm_yr),
                                    .(n_recipes = .N,
                                      n_pos = sum(trend_cm_yr > 0),
                                      n_neg = sum(trend_cm_yr < 0),
                                      n_zero = sum(trend_cm_yr == 0),
                                      min_trend = min(trend_cm_yr),
                                      max_trend = max(trend_cm_yr),
                                      median_trend = median(trend_cm_yr)),
                                    by = Study_area]
sign_paradox[, frac_pos := n_pos / n_recipes]
sign_paradox[, frac_neg := n_neg / n_recipes]
sign_paradox[, sign_agree := pmax(frac_pos, frac_neg)]
sign_paradox[, sign_flips := pmin(frac_pos, frac_neg)]
sign_paradox[, spans_zero := (min_trend < 0) & (max_trend > 0)]
# Robust paradox counts -- a single dissenting recipe (spans_zero = TRUE
# with sign_flips ~ 1/1920) is the min-max headline; the stricter 5% and
# 10% cuts defuse it.
sign_paradox[, paradox_gt05 := sign_flips >= 0.05]
sign_paradox[, paradox_gt10 := sign_flips >= 0.10]

cat("\n=== The sign paradox: how often does preprocessing flip the verdict? ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Cohort size: %d aquifers\n", nrow(sign_paradox)))
cat(sprintf("\nAquifers spanned by recipes of both signs (min < 0 AND max > 0):\n"))
cat(sprintf("  %d of %d aquifers (%.1f%% of the cohort)\n",
              sum(sign_paradox$spans_zero), nrow(sign_paradox),
              mean(sign_paradox$spans_zero) * 100))
cat("\n--- Robust paradox thresholds (excluding single-extreme-recipe cases):\n")
cat(sprintf("  >=5%% of recipes return the minority sign:  %d of %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(sign_paradox$paradox_gt05), nrow(sign_paradox),
            mean(sign_paradox$paradox_gt05) * 100))
cat(sprintf("  >=10%% of recipes return the minority sign: %d of %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(sign_paradox$paradox_gt10), nrow(sign_paradox),
            mean(sign_paradox$paradox_gt10) * 100))

# Size-cut insensitivity: the paradox share at increasing area thresholds.
.sp_area <- merge(sign_paradox[, .(Study_area, spans_zero)],
                  cohort[, .(Study_area, area_km2)], by = "Study_area")
cat("\n--- Paradox share by minimum-area threshold ---\n")
for (.th in c(5e4, 1e5, 1.5e5, 2e5))
  cat(sprintf("  area >= %7s km2: %d of %d (%.0f%%)\n",
              format(.th, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
              .sp_area[area_km2 >= .th, sum(spans_zero)],
              .sp_area[area_km2 >= .th, .N],
              100 * .sp_area[area_km2 >= .th, mean(spans_zero)]))

cat("\n--- Sign-agreement distribution across the cohort ---\n")
cat(sprintf("  median sign-agreement: %.3f\n",
              stats::median(sign_paradox$sign_agree)))
cat(sprintf("  minimum sign-agreement: %.3f  (coin-flip case)\n",
              min(sign_paradox$sign_agree)))
cat(sprintf("  # aquifers with sign-agreement < 0.95: %d\n",
              sum(sign_paradox$sign_agree < 0.95)))
cat(sprintf("  # aquifers with sign-agreement < 0.90: %d\n",
              sum(sign_paradox$sign_agree < 0.90)))
cat(sprintf("  # aquifers with sign-agreement < 0.75: %d\n",
              sum(sign_paradox$sign_agree < 0.75)))
cat(sprintf("  # aquifers with sign-agreement < 0.55 (effective coin flip): %d\n",
              sum(sign_paradox$sign_agree < 0.55)))

cat("\n--- Sign-agreement tracks dominance R ---\n")
sp_R <- merge(sign_paradox,
                gradient_data[, .(Study_area, dominance_R)],
                by = "Study_area")
rho_sa_R <- stats::cor(sp_R$sign_agree, sp_R$dominance_R,
                          method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
cat(sprintf("  Spearman rho(sign-agreement, dominance R) = %+.3f\n", rho_sa_R))
cat(sprintf("  median R among sign-flippers (sign_agree < 0.95): %.2f\n",
              stats::median(sp_R[sign_agree < 0.95, dominance_R],
                              na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  median R among sign-consensus (sign_agree >= 0.95): %.2f\n",
              stats::median(sp_R[sign_agree >= 0.95, dominance_R],
                              na.rm = TRUE)))

cat("\n--- 15 most sign-paradoxical aquifers ---\n")
data.table::setorder(sign_paradox, sign_agree)
print(sign_paradox[1:15, .(Study_area,
                              frac_pos = round(frac_pos, 3),
                              frac_neg = round(frac_neg, 3),
                              sign_agree = round(sign_agree, 3),
                              median_trend = round(median_trend, 3),
                              min_trend = round(min_trend, 3),
                              max_trend = round(max_trend, 3))])
```

# FIG: SIGN PARADOX ##########################################################

# Subset to sign-paradox aquifers (those with both positive and negative
# recipes among the 1,920) and order by sign_agree ascending.
sp_subset <- sign_paradox[spans_zero == TRUE]
data.table::setorder(sp_subset, sign_agree)

short_label_for <- function(s) {
  m <- regmatches(s, regexec("^(.*?)\\s*\\((.*)\\)\\s*$", s))[[1L]]
  if (length(m) == 3L) {
    broader <- m[3L]
    sub <- m[2L]
    broader <- gsub(" (Aquifer System|Basin)$", "", broader)
    paste0(broader, " -- ", sub)
  } else {
    s
  }
}

paradox_order <- sp_subset[, Study_area]
panel_sp <- per_recipe_trends[Study_area %in% paradox_order &
                                !is.na(trend_cm_yr)]
panel_sp[, Study_area := factor(Study_area, levels = rev(paradox_order))]
panel_sp[, sign_lab := factor(ifelse(trend_cm_yr >= 0,
                                        "gaining", "depleting"),
                                levels = c("depleting", "gaining"))]
medians_sp <- panel_sp[, .(med = stats::median(trend_cm_yr)),
                          by = Study_area]
sp_label_map <- vapply(levels(panel_sp$Study_area),
                          short_label_for, character(1L))

plot_sign_flip <- ggplot(panel_sp,
        aes(x = trend_cm_yr, y = Study_area, colour = sign_lab)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
              linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.28, size = 0.3,
              alpha = 0.4, shape = 16) +
  geom_segment(data = medians_sp,
                aes(x = med, xend = med,
                    y = as.numeric(Study_area) - 0.4,
                    yend = as.numeric(Study_area) + 0.4),
                inherit.aes = FALSE,
                colour = "black", linewidth = 0.45) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = sp_label_map) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("depleting" = "#8b3a3a",
                                    "gaining"   = "#3a7a3a"),
                       guide = "none") +
  labs(x = expression(paste("trend (cm yr"^-1, ")")),
        y = NULL) +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))

# Well validation

Sign agreement with in-situ wells above and below the boundary.

```{r well-binomial, cache.extra=file.mtime(here::here("datasets","output","robustness","well_grace_sign_validation.csv"))}

# WELL-AGREEMENT BINOMIAL TESTS ###############################################
# Above/below the 0.35 cm/yr boundary: number of aquifers (>= 10 monitored
# wells) whose well trend agrees in sign with the recipe-median trend, with a
# one-sided binomial test against 0.5.

.wv <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output", "robustness",
                                    "well_grace_sign_validation.csv"))
wbin <- lapply(c(above = TRUE, below = FALSE), function(g) {
  s  <- .wv[grace_detectable == g]
  k  <- sum(s$agree); n <- nrow(s)
  bt <- stats::binom.test(k, n, p = 0.5, alternative = "greater")
  ci <- stats::binom.test(k, n)$conf.int
  list(k = k, n = n, pct = 100 * k / n, p = bt$p.value,
       lo = ci[1L], hi = ci[2L])
})
for (g in names(wbin)) {
  b <- wbin[[g]]
  cat(sprintf("%s boundary: %d / %d agree (%.0f%%) | one-sided binomial p vs 0.5 = %.3g | exact 95%% CI %.2f--%.2f\n",
              g, b$k, b$n, b$pct, b$p, b$lo, b$hi))
}
stopifnot(round(100 * c(wbin$above$lo, wbin$above$hi)) == c(55, 78),
          round(100 * c(wbin$below$lo, wbin$below$hi)) == c(42, 60))

# Direct above-vs-below contrast, cutoff sweep, system-cluster bootstrap ------
.ft <- stats::fisher.test(.wv[, table(grace_detectable, agree)])
.diff <- .wv[grace_detectable == TRUE, mean(agree)] -
  .wv[grace_detectable == FALSE, mean(agree)]
stopifnot(round(100 * .diff, 1) == 16.8, round(.ft$estimate, 2) == 2.01,
          round(.ft$p.value, 3) == 0.025)
.sweep <- vapply(c(0.28, 0.30, 0.35, 0.39, 0.42), function(cut)
  stats::fisher.test(.wv[, table(abs_median >= cut, agree)])$p.value,
  numeric(1))
stopifnot(round(range(.sweep), 3) == c(0.016, 0.267))
.wv[, system := data.table::fifelse(grepl("\\(", Study_area),
     sub(".*\\(([^)]+)\\).*", "\\1", Study_area), Study_area)]
.sys <- unique(.wv$system)
set.seed(71)
.bd <- replicate(4000, {
  b <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(sample(.sys, replace = TRUE),
                                    function(x) .wv[system == x]))
  b[grace_detectable == TRUE, mean(agree)] -
    b[grace_detectable == FALSE, mean(agree)]
})
.bd <- .bd[is.finite(.bd)]
stopifnot(round(100 * stats::quantile(.bd, c(0.025, 0.975)), 0) == c(-5, 39),
          round(mean(.bd <= 0), 2) == 0.06)
cat(sprintf("direct contrast: %.1f pp, OR %.2f, Fisher p %.3f; sweep p %.3f-%.3f; cluster diff CI [%.0f, %.0f] pp, frac<=0 %.2f\n",
            100 * .diff, .ft$estimate, .ft$p.value, min(.sweep), max(.sweep),
            100 * stats::quantile(.bd, 0.025), 100 * stats::quantile(.bd, 0.975),
            mean(.bd <= 0)))
```

# Stochastic trend error

```{r noise-boundary, dependson="load-tier-a", cache.extra=file.mtime(here::here("datasets","output","tier_a","per_recipe_trend_se.csv.gz"))}

# NOISE-BASED COUNTERPART TO THE DETECTABILITY BOUNDARY #######################
# Per-recipe AR(1)-adjusted trend standard errors, reduced to an aquifer-level noise criterion and crossed with the recipe
# ensemble's detectability classes.

se_dt <- data.table::fread(cmd = paste("gunzip -c", shQuote(here::here(
  "datasets", "output", "tier_a", "per_recipe_trend_se.csv.gz"))))
se_t1 <- se_dt[Study_area %in% unique(per_recipe_trends$Study_area)]
stopifnot(data.table::uniqueN(se_t1$Study_area) == 73L,
          nrow(se_t1) == nrow(per_recipe_trends))

nb_aq <- merge(
  se_t1[, .(med_se = stats::median(se_ar1),
            frac_sig = mean(abs(trend_seas_cmyr) > 1.96 * se_ar1),
            med_rho1 = stats::median(rho1)), by = Study_area],
  per_recipe_trends[!is.na(trend_cm_yr), .(
    med_t = stats::median(trend_cm_yr),
    spans = (min(trend_cm_yr) < 0) & (max(trend_cm_yr) > 0)),
    by = Study_area],
  by = "Study_area")
nb_aq[, `:=`(noise_th = 1.96 * med_se,
             noise_insig = abs(med_t) < 1.96 * med_se)]

nb_both   <- nb_aq[spans & noise_insig, .N]
nb_recipe <- nb_aq[spans & !noise_insig, .N]
nb_noise  <- nb_aq[!spans & noise_insig, .N]
nb_none   <- nb_aq[!spans & !noise_insig, .N]
nb_union  <- nb_aq[spans | noise_insig, .N]
nb_th_med <- stats::median(nb_aq$noise_th)
nb_th_rng <- range(nb_aq$noise_th)

cat("=== Stochastic trend error vs the recipe boundary (Tier 1, 73) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  per-recipe noise model          : median rho1 %.2f, median AR(1) SE %.3f cm/yr\n",
            stats::median(se_t1$rho1), stats::median(se_t1$se_ar1)))
cat(sprintf("  aquifer noise threshold 1.96*SE : median %.2f cm/yr, range %.2f--%.2f\n",
            nb_th_med, nb_th_rng[1], nb_th_rng[2]))
cat(sprintf("  recipe-paradoxical only         : %d\n", nb_recipe))
cat(sprintf("  noise-non-adjudicable only      : %d\n", nb_noise))
cat(sprintf("  both                            : %d\n", nb_both))
cat(sprintf("  neither (fully adjudicable)     : %d\n", nb_none))
cat(sprintf("  union non-adjudicable           : %d of 73 (%.0f%%)  [recipe alone: %d]\n",
            nb_union, 100 * nb_union / 73, nb_aq[spans == TRUE, .N]))
cat(sprintf("  median frac of recipes with individually significant trends: %.2f\n",
            stats::median(nb_aq$frac_sig)))
```

# Rolling windows

# ROLLING-WINDOW SIGN STABILITY ##############################################
# Per (aquifer, window): pooled positive fraction, median trend,
# spans-both-signs.

rw <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output", "tier_a",
                                   "rolling_window_signs.csv"))
rw73 <- rw[Study_area %in% unique(per_recipe_trends$Study_area)]
stopifnot(data.table::uniqueN(rw73$Study_area) == 73L)

rw_aq <- rw73[, .(
  n_win = .N,
  win_flip = data.table::uniqueN(sign(med_trend_cmyr[med_trend_cmyr != 0])) > 1L,
  frac_win_spans = mean(spans),
  n_win_consensus = sum(!spans)), by = Study_area]
rw_aq <- merge(rw_aq,
               per_recipe_trends[!is.na(trend_cm_yr), .(
                 spans_full = (min(trend_cm_yr) < 0) & (max(trend_cm_yr) > 0),
                 abs_med_full = abs(stats::median(trend_cm_yr))),
                 by = Study_area], by = "Study_area")

rw_both   <- rw_aq[win_flip & spans_full, .N]
rw_winonly <- rw_aq[win_flip & !spans_full, .N]
rw_reconly <- rw_aq[!win_flip & spans_full, .N]
rw_stable <- rw_aq[!win_flip & !spans_full, .N]

cat("=== Rolling-window sign stability (73 aquifers x 15 windows) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  median-sign reverses across windows (window-unstable): %d of 73\n",
            rw_aq[win_flip == TRUE, .N]))
cat(sprintf("  window-unstable AND recipe-paradoxical               : %d\n", rw_both))
cat(sprintf("  window-unstable only (recipe-consensus, non-monotonic): %d\n", rw_winonly))
cat(sprintf("  recipe-paradoxical only (window-stable)              : %d\n", rw_reconly))
cat(sprintf("  stable under both                                     : %d\n", rw_stable))
cat(sprintf("  median share of windows whose ensemble spans zero    : %.2f\n",
            stats::median(rw_aq$frac_win_spans)))
.murray <- rw73[grepl("Murray", Study_area)][order(win_start)]
if (nrow(.murray)) cat(sprintf("  Murray sign by window: %s\n",
  paste(ifelse(.murray$med_trend_cmyr > 0, "+", "-"), collapse = "")))

# Tile figure prep: aquifer x window, fill = fraction of recipes positive -----

rw_plot <- merge(rw73, rw_aq[, .(Study_area, abs_med_full)],
                 by = "Study_area")
.lev <- rw_aq[order(abs_med_full), Study_area]            # ascending |median|
.n_rw <- length(.lev); .half_rw <- ceiling(.n_rw / 2)
rw_grp_strong <- .lev[(.n_rw - .half_rw + 1):.n_rw]       # top of the plot
rw_grp_weak   <- .lev[1:(.n_rw - .half_rw)]

rw_aq[, short0 := sub(" \\([^)]*\\)$", "", Study_area)]
.dup_rw <- rw_aq[, .N, by = short0][N > 1, short0]
rw_aq[, short := data.table::fifelse(short0 %in% .dup_rw, Study_area, short0)]
rw_lab_map <- stats::setNames(rw_aq$short, rw_aq$Study_area)

build_rolling <- function(levs) {
  d <- rw_plot[Study_area %in% levs]
  d[, aq_lab := factor(Study_area, levels = levs)]
  ggplot(d, aes(x = factor(win_start), y = aq_lab, fill = frac_pos)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#a01010", mid = "white", high = "#1d7a32",
                         midpoint = 0.5, limits = c(0, 1),
                         name = "fraction of recipes\nwith positive trend") +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = rw_lab_map) +
    labs(x = "window start year (10-year windows)", y = NULL) +
    theme_AP() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "top")
}

# Robustness variants

```{r robustness-subset-a, dependson="load-tier-a"}

# ROBUSTNESS SUBSET A -- THE FULLY-CORRECTED RECIPE SUBSET ####################

# Subset A: only fully-corrected recipes (SLR C20 + C30, GravIS degree-1, one
# of the three GIA models) = 180 recipes; removes the objection that
# do-nothing null levels manufacture the paradox.

# R = 1 crossing of a loess fit in log-log space (identical to boundary-ci).
r1_loess_local <- function(x, y, span = 0.75, grid_n = 400L) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y) & x > 0 & y > 0
  if (sum(ok) < 10L) return(NA_real_)
  lx <- log10(x[ok]); ly <- log10(y[ok])
  fit <- tryCatch(stats::loess(ly ~ lx, span = span,
            control = stats::loess.control(surface = "direct")),
            error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
  gx <- seq(min(lx), max(lx), length.out = grid_n)
  gy <- suppressWarnings(stats::predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(lx = gx)))
  gx <- unname(gx); gy <- unname(gy)
  s <- which(gy[-1] < 0 & gy[-length(gy)] >= 0)
  if (length(s) == 0L) return(NA_real_)
  i <- s[1L]
  as.numeric(10^(gx[i] + (0 - gy[i]) / (gy[i + 1L] - gy[i]) *
                 (gx[i + 1L] - gx[i])))
}
boot_r1_local <- function(x, y, n_boot = 2000L, seed = 71L) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y) & x > 0 & y > 0
  x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
  est <- r1_loess_local(x, y)
  set.seed(seed)
  bs <- replicate(n_boot, { i <- sample.int(length(x), replace = TRUE)
    r1_loess_local(x[i], y[i]) })
  bs <- bs[is.finite(bs)]
  ci <- stats::quantile(bs, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  list(est = as.numeric(est), lo = ci[[1L]], hi = ci[[2L]])
}

# Per-aquifer headline statistics for an arbitrary per-recipe subset.
headline_subset <- function(dt) {
  aq <- dt[!is.na(trend_cm_yr), .(
    n_rec = .N, min_t = min(trend_cm_yr), max_t = max(trend_cm_yr),
    med_t = stats::median(trend_cm_yr),
    iqr_t = stats::IQR(trend_cm_yr)), by = Study_area]
  aq[, `:=`(spans_zero = (min_t < 0) & (max_t > 0), abs_t = abs(med_t))]
  aq[, R := iqr_t / abs_t]
  ok <- is.finite(aq$abs_t) & is.finite(aq$R)
  rho <- stats::cor(aq$abs_t[ok], aq$R[ok], method = "spearman")
  set.seed(43L)
  xb <- aq$abs_t[ok]; yb <- aq$R[ok]
  rb <- replicate(2000L, { i <- sample.int(length(xb), replace = TRUE)
    suppressWarnings(stats::cor(xb[i], yb[i], method = "spearman")) })
  rci <- stats::quantile(rb, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  bnd <- boot_r1_local(aq$abs_t, aq$R)
  list(n_rec = aq$n_rec[1L], n_aq = nrow(aq), n_par = sum(aq$spans_zero),
       pct_par = 100 * mean(aq$spans_zero), rho = rho,
       rho_lo = rci[[1L]], rho_hi = rci[[2L]],
       bnd = bnd[["est"]], bnd_lo = bnd[["lo"]], bnd_hi = bnd[["hi"]])
}

subset_a <- per_recipe_trends[c20_treatment == "replaced" &
                                c30_treatment == "replaced" &
                                geocenter == "GravIS" & gia_model != "none"]
rob_full <- headline_subset(per_recipe_trends)
rob_subA <- headline_subset(subset_a)

cat("=== Robustness subset A: headline stats without the null recipes ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  recipes per aquifer          full %4d        subset A %4d\n",
            rob_full$n_rec, rob_subA$n_rec))
cat(sprintf("  sign-paradoxical aquifers    full %2d/%d (%4.1f%%)  subset A %2d/%d (%4.1f%%)\n",
            rob_full$n_par, rob_full$n_aq, rob_full$pct_par,
            rob_subA$n_par, rob_subA$n_aq, rob_subA$pct_par))
cat(sprintf("  gradient rho (aquifer-mean)  full %+.2f [%+.2f,%+.2f] subset A %+.2f [%+.2f,%+.2f]\n",
            rob_full$rho, rob_full$rho_lo, rob_full$rho_hi,
            rob_subA$rho, rob_subA$rho_lo, rob_subA$rho_hi))
cat(sprintf("  R = 1 boundary (cm/yr EWH)   full %.2f [%.2f,%.2f]  subset A %.2f [%.2f,%.2f]\n",
            rob_full$bnd, rob_full$bnd_lo, rob_full$bnd_hi,
            rob_subA$bnd, rob_subA$bnd_lo, rob_subA$bnd_hi))
```

# STRIPE-RESIDUAL CRITERION ##################################################
# Per-recipe stripe index inherited from the recipe's (centre, truncation,
# filter) damping combination; headline statistics on the recipes whose
# index falls in the lower (cleaner) half.

stripes <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output", "tier_a",
                                        "recipe_stripe_index.csv"))
.st <- merge(per_recipe_trends, stripes,
             by = c("centre", "truncation", "filter"))
stopifnot(nrow(.st) == nrow(per_recipe_trends))
.cmb <- unique(stripes[, .(centre, truncation, filter, stripe_idx)])
st_th50 <- stats::median(.cmb$stripe_idx)
st_th25 <- stats::quantile(.cmb$stripe_idx, 0.25)
rob_st50 <- headline_subset(.st[stripe_idx <= st_th50])
rob_st25 <- headline_subset(.st[stripe_idx <= st_th25])

cat("=== Stripe-residual criterion: cleanest-damping subsets ===\n")
cat("  stripe index by filter (mean over centre x truncation):\n")
print(.cmb[, .(stripe_idx = round(mean(stripe_idx), 3)),
           keyby = filter][order(stripe_idx)])
cat(sprintf("\n  cleanest half   : %d recipes/aquifer, paradox %d/%d (%.0f%%), boundary %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
            rob_st50$n_rec, rob_st50$n_par, rob_st50$n_aq,
            rob_st50$pct_par, rob_st50$bnd, rob_st50$bnd_lo,
            rob_st50$bnd_hi))
cat(sprintf("  cleanest quarter: %d recipes/aquifer, paradox %d/%d (%.0f%%), boundary %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
            rob_st25$n_rec, rob_st25$n_par, rob_st25$n_aq,
            rob_st25$pct_par, rob_st25$bnd, rob_st25$bnd_lo,
            rob_st25$bnd_hi))
cat(sprintf("  (full ensemble  : 1920 recipes/aquifer, paradox %d/%d (%.0f%%), boundary %.2f)\n",
            rob_full$n_par, rob_full$n_aq, rob_full$pct_par, rob_full$bnd))

```{r robustness-lit-weights, dependson=c("load-tier-a","robustness-subset-a"), cache.extra=file.mtime(here::here("datasets","bibliometric","bibliometric_master_all.csv"))}

# LITERATURE-WEIGHTED RECIPE ENSEMBLE #########################################
# Weight w_r = number of unique own-SHM papers whose stated method is
# compatible with recipe r (literature_recipe_match_fun; unstated axes match
# all levels, multi-valued axes each stated level).

.lw_bib <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "bibliometric",
                                        "bibliometric_master_all.csv"))
.lw_bib <- unique(.lw_bib[paper_category == "own-SHM"], by = "oa_id")
.lw_canon_gia <- function(x) {
  x0 <- tolower(x)
  data.table::fcase(
    grepl("caron", x0),                   "Caron_2018",
    grepl("ice.?6g|ice6g", x0),           "Peltier_ICE6G_D",
    grepl("ice.?5g|ice5g|geruo|vm2", x0), "Geruo_ICE5G_VM2",
    x0 == "none",                         "none",
    default = x)
}
.lw_canon_filter <- function(x) {
  x0 <- tolower(x)
  data.table::fcase(
    grepl("swenson", x0) & grepl("500", x0), "Swenson_G500",
    grepl("swenson", x0) & grepl("300", x0), "Swenson_G300",
    default = x)
}
.lw_bib[, gia_model := .lw_canon_gia(gia_model)]
.lw_bib[, filter    := .lw_canon_filter(filter)]

.lw_axes <- c("centre", "truncation", "filter", "gia_model",
              "c20_treatment", "c30_treatment", "geocenter")
.lw_grid <- per_recipe_skill[, .(recipe_idx = .I, centre, truncation,
                                  filter, gia_model, c20_treatment,
                                  c30_treatment, geocenter)]
.lw_matches <- literature_recipe_match_fun(.lw_bib, .lw_grid)
.lw_grid <- merge(.lw_grid,
                  .lw_matches[, .(w = .N), by = recipe_idx],
                  by = "recipe_idx", all.x = TRUE)
.lw_grid[is.na(w), w := 0L]

lw_wmin <- min(.lw_grid$w); lw_wmed <- stats::median(.lw_grid$w)
lw_wmax <- max(.lw_grid$w)
lw_ess  <- sum(.lw_grid$w)^2 / sum(.lw_grid$w^2)

.lw_tr <- merge(per_recipe_trends,
                .lw_grid[, c(.lw_axes, "w"), with = FALSE], by = .lw_axes)

.lw_wq <- function(x, w, p) {
  o <- order(x); x <- x[o]; w <- w[o]
  cw <- (cumsum(w) - 0.5 * w) / sum(w)
  stats::approx(cw, x, xout = p, rule = 2)$y
}
lw_aq <- .lw_tr[!is.na(trend_cm_yr), {
  q    <- .lw_wq(trend_cm_yr, w, c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
  wpos <- sum(w[trend_cm_yr > 0]); wneg <- sum(w[trend_cm_yr < 0])
  upos <- sum(trend_cm_yr > 0);    uneg <- sum(trend_cm_yr < 0)
  .(wmed  = q[2L], wiqr = q[3L] - q[1L],
    min_w = min(wpos, wneg) / (wpos + wneg),
    min_u = min(upos, uneg) / (upos + uneg))
}, by = Study_area]
lw_aq[, `:=`(abs_t = abs(wmed), R = wiqr / abs(wmed))]

lw_pct_par  <- 100 * mean(lw_aq$min_w > 0)
lw_min5     <- sum(lw_aq$min_w >= 0.05); lw_min5_u  <- sum(lw_aq$min_u >= 0.05)
lw_min10    <- sum(lw_aq$min_w >= 0.10); lw_min10_u <- sum(lw_aq$min_u >= 0.10)
lw_med_sa_w <- stats::median(1 - lw_aq$min_w)
lw_med_sa_u <- stats::median(1 - lw_aq$min_u)
lw_rho      <- stats::cor(lw_aq$abs_t, lw_aq$R, method = "spearman")
lw_bnd      <- boot_r1_local(lw_aq$abs_t, lw_aq$R)

cat("=== Literature-weighted ensemble: headline stats under corpus weights ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  papers contributing weights         : %d (all own-SHM unique)\n",
            data.table::uniqueN(.lw_matches$paper_id)))
cat(sprintf("  recipe weights                      : min %d, median %.0f, max %d; ESS %.0f of 1,920\n",
            lw_wmin, lw_wmed, lw_wmax, lw_ess))
cat(sprintf("  sign-paradoxical (weighted support) : %d / 73 (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(lw_aq$min_w > 0), lw_pct_par))
cat(sprintf("  minority weight >= 5%% / >= 10%%      : %d / %d  (unweighted %d / %d)\n",
            lw_min5, lw_min10, lw_min5_u, lw_min10_u))
cat(sprintf("  median sign-agreement               : weighted %.3f, unweighted %.3f\n",
            lw_med_sa_w, lw_med_sa_u))
cat(sprintf("  gradient rho (weighted)             : %+.2f\n", lw_rho))
cat(sprintf("  R = 1 boundary (weighted, cm/yr)    : %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]  (full ensemble %.2f [%.2f, %.2f])\n",
            lw_bnd$est, lw_bnd$lo, lw_bnd$hi,
            rob_full$bnd, rob_full$bnd_lo, rob_full$bnd_hi))
```

```{r robustness-gws, dependson=c("load-tier-a","robustness-subset-a"), cache.extra=c(file.mtime(here::here("datasets","output","tier_a","gws_aux_trends.csv")), file.mtime(here::here("datasets","output","tier_a","gws_aux_trends_era5land.csv")))}

# GWS ROBUSTNESS -- SUBTRACTING THE RECIPE-INDEPENDENT AUXILIARY ##############
# trend(GWS_r) = trend(TWS_r) - trend(AUX), with AUX fitted per (centre, truncation)
# on each recipe's own valid months (month-exact), so block spreads are preserved.

gws_aux <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output", "tier_a",
                                        "gws_aux_trends.csv"))
stopifnot(length(setdiff(unique(per_recipe_trends$Study_area),
                         unique(gws_aux$Study_area))) == 0L)
# The auxiliary is fitted per (centre, truncation) valid-month set (the JPL
# month set is truncation-specific), so the join carries truncation too.
gws_trends <- merge(per_recipe_trends,
                    gws_aux[, .(Study_area, centre, truncation,
                                aux_trend_cmyr)],
                    by = c("Study_area", "centre", "truncation"))
stopifnot(nrow(gws_trends) == nrow(per_recipe_trends))
gws_trends[, trend_cm_yr := trend_cm_yr - aux_trend_cmyr]

# Exactness check: per-aquifer recipe IQR unchanged to float precision -------

.iqr_chk <- merge(
  per_recipe_trends[!is.na(trend_cm_yr),
                    .(iqr_tws = stats::IQR(trend_cm_yr)), by = Study_area],
  gws_trends[!is.na(trend_cm_yr),
             .(iqr_gws = stats::IQR(trend_cm_yr)), by = Study_area],
  by = "Study_area")[, max(abs(iqr_tws - iqr_gws))]

# Headline statistics on the GWS ensemble -------------------------------------

rob_gws      <- headline_subset(gws_trends)
rob_gws_subA <- headline_subset(gws_trends[c20_treatment == "replaced" &
                                             c30_treatment == "replaced" &
                                             geocenter == "GravIS" &
                                             gia_model != "none"])

# Paradox-set turnover and sign-agreement shift -------------------------------

.gws_sa_fun <- function(dt) dt[!is.na(trend_cm_yr), .(
  spans = (min(trend_cm_yr) < 0) & (max(trend_cm_yr) > 0),
  sa = max(mean(trend_cm_yr > 0), mean(trend_cm_yr < 0))), by = Study_area]
.gws_sa <- merge(.gws_sa_fun(per_recipe_trends), .gws_sa_fun(gws_trends),
                 by = "Study_area", suffixes = c("_tws", "_gws"))
gws_enter <- .gws_sa[!spans_tws & spans_gws, Study_area]
gws_leave <- .gws_sa[spans_tws & !spans_gws, Study_area]
gws_med_sa_tws <- stats::median(.gws_sa$sa_tws)
gws_med_sa     <- stats::median(.gws_sa$sa_gws)

.aux1 <- gws_aux[Study_area %in% per_recipe_trends$Study_area,
                 .(aux_trend_cmyr = mean(aux_trend_cmyr)), by = Study_area]

cat("=== GWS robustness: the ensemble after the groundwater correction ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  auxiliary trend (73 aquifers)   : median %+.3f cm/yr, IQR [%+.3f, %+.3f], range [%+.2f, %+.2f]\n",
            stats::median(.aux1$aux_trend_cmyr),
            stats::quantile(.aux1$aux_trend_cmyr, 0.25),
            stats::quantile(.aux1$aux_trend_cmyr, 0.75),
            min(.aux1$aux_trend_cmyr), max(.aux1$aux_trend_cmyr)))
cat(sprintf("  IQR preservation (max abs diff) : %.2e cm/yr\n", .iqr_chk))
cat(sprintf("  sign-paradoxical                : TWS %d/%d (%.1f%%)  GWS %d/%d (%.1f%%)\n",
            rob_full$n_par, rob_full$n_aq, rob_full$pct_par,
            rob_gws$n_par, rob_gws$n_aq, rob_gws$pct_par))
cat(sprintf("  paradox-set turnover            : %d enter, %d leave\n",
            length(gws_enter), length(gws_leave)))
if (length(gws_enter)) cat("    enter:", paste(gws_enter, collapse = "; "), "\n")
if (length(gws_leave)) cat("    leave:", paste(gws_leave, collapse = "; "), "\n")
cat(sprintf("  median sign-agreement           : TWS %.3f  GWS %.3f (shift %+.3f)\n",
            gws_med_sa_tws, gws_med_sa, gws_med_sa - gws_med_sa_tws))
cat(sprintf("  R = 1 boundary (cm/yr)          : TWS %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]  GWS %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
            rob_full$bnd, rob_full$bnd_lo, rob_full$bnd_hi,
            rob_gws$bnd, rob_gws$bnd_lo, rob_gws$bnd_hi))
cat(sprintf("  fully corrected (180) on GWS    : paradox %d/%d (%.1f%%), boundary %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]  (TWS: %d/%d, %.2f)\n",
            rob_gws_subA$n_par, rob_gws_subA$n_aq, rob_gws_subA$pct_par,
            rob_gws_subA$bnd, rob_gws_subA$bnd_lo, rob_gws_subA$bnd_hi,
            rob_subA$n_par, rob_subA$n_aq, rob_subA$bnd))

# Second auxiliary -- ERA5-Land (ECMWF): auxiliary-model variance -------------
# Same subtraction with an independent modelling system (ERA5-Land: swvl1-4 x
# layer thickness + snow water equivalent + skin reservoir, cm; aggregated
# by the same cell masks.

era5_aux <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output", "tier_a",
                                         "gws_aux_trends_era5land.csv"))
gws_trends_e5 <- merge(per_recipe_trends,
                       era5_aux[, .(Study_area, centre, truncation,
                                    aux_trend_cmyr)],
                       by = c("Study_area", "centre", "truncation"))
stopifnot(nrow(gws_trends_e5) == nrow(per_recipe_trends))
gws_trends_e5[, trend_cm_yr := trend_cm_yr - aux_trend_cmyr]
rob_gws_e5 <- headline_subset(gws_trends_e5)

.aux2 <- era5_aux[Study_area %in% per_recipe_trends$Study_area,
                  .(aux_trend_cmyr = mean(aux_trend_cmyr)),
                  by = Study_area]
aux_diff <- merge(
  merge(.aux1[, .(Study_area, gldas = aux_trend_cmyr)],
        .aux2[, .(Study_area, era5 = aux_trend_cmyr)], by = "Study_area"),
  per_recipe_trends[!is.na(trend_cm_yr),
                    .(iqr_tws = stats::IQR(trend_cm_yr)), by = Study_area],
  by = "Study_area")
aux_diff[, `:=`(d = era5 - gldas)]
aux_mod_med   <- stats::median(abs(aux_diff$d))
aux_mod_max   <- max(abs(aux_diff$d))
aux_mod_rho   <- stats::cor(aux_diff$gldas, aux_diff$era5,
                            method = "spearman")
aux_mod_ratio <- stats::median(abs(aux_diff$d) / aux_diff$iqr_tws)

cat("\n=== Second auxiliary: ERA5-Land (independent modelling system) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  ERA5-Land auxiliary trend       : median %+.3f cm/yr, range [%+.2f, %+.2f]\n",
            stats::median(.aux2$aux_trend_cmyr),
            min(.aux2$aux_trend_cmyr), max(.aux2$aux_trend_cmyr)))
cat(sprintf("  sign-paradoxical (GWS, ERA5)    : %d/%d (%.1f%%)   (GLDAS %d/%d, %.1f%%)\n",
            rob_gws_e5$n_par, rob_gws_e5$n_aq, rob_gws_e5$pct_par,
            rob_gws$n_par, rob_gws$n_aq, rob_gws$pct_par))
cat(sprintf("  R = 1 boundary (GWS, ERA5)      : %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]   (GLDAS %.2f [%.2f, %.2f])\n",
            rob_gws_e5$bnd, rob_gws_e5$bnd_lo, rob_gws_e5$bnd_hi,
            rob_gws$bnd, rob_gws$bnd_lo, rob_gws$bnd_hi))
cat(sprintf("  auxiliary-model difference      : median |d| %.3f cm/yr, max %.2f, Spearman rho %.2f\n",
            aux_mod_med, aux_mod_max, aux_mod_rho))
cat(sprintf("  median |d| / recipe IQR         : %.2f (auxiliary-model variance ON TOP of the recipe spread)\n",
            aux_mod_ratio))

```{r robustness-1deg-gain, dependson=c("load-tier-a","robustness-subset-a"), cache.extra=c(file.mtime(here::here("datasets","output","tier_a","sensitivity_1deg_per_recipe_trends.csv.gz")), file.mtime(here::here("datasets","output","tier_a","sensitivity_gain_per_recipe_trends.csv.gz")))}

# 1-DEGREE RE-SYNTHESIS + CELL-LEVEL GAIN-FACTOR BRANCH #######################
# Both ensembles come from the SAME per-cell slopes as the headline reduction.

deg1_trends <- data.table::fread(here::here(
  "datasets", "output", "tier_a",
  "sensitivity_1deg_per_recipe_trends.csv.gz"))
gain_trends <- data.table::fread(here::here(
  "datasets", "output", "tier_a",
  "sensitivity_gain_per_recipe_trends.csv.gz"))
stopifnot(nrow(deg1_trends) == nrow(per_recipe_trends),
          nrow(gain_trends) == nrow(per_recipe_trends))

rob_d1 <- headline_subset(deg1_trends)
rob_gn <- headline_subset(gain_trends)

# Per-aquifer pooled-median shift under the 1-degree re-synthesis ------------

.d1_med <- merge(
  per_recipe_trends[!is.na(trend_cm_yr),
                    .(med_05 = stats::median(trend_cm_yr)), by = Study_area],
  deg1_trends[!is.na(trend_cm_yr),
              .(med_10 = stats::median(trend_cm_yr)), by = Study_area],
  by = "Study_area")
.d1_med[, d := med_10 - med_05]
d1_shift_med <- stats::median(abs(.d1_med$d))
d1_shift_max <- max(abs(.d1_med$d))

# Paradox-set turnover for both branches --------------------------------------

.sb_fun <- function(dt) dt[!is.na(trend_cm_yr), .(
  spans = (min(trend_cm_yr) < 0) & (max(trend_cm_yr) > 0)), by = Study_area]
.sb_base <- .sb_fun(per_recipe_trends)
.d1_sb <- merge(.sb_base, .sb_fun(deg1_trends), by = "Study_area",
                suffixes = c("_b", "_v"))
.gn_sb <- merge(.sb_base, .sb_fun(gain_trends), by = "Study_area",
                suffixes = c("_b", "_v"))
d1_enter <- .d1_sb[!spans_b & spans_v, Study_area]
d1_leave <- .d1_sb[spans_b & !spans_v, Study_area]
gn_enter <- .gn_sb[!spans_b & spans_v, Study_area]
gn_leave <- .gn_sb[spans_b & !spans_v, Study_area]

# Gain-grid coverage over the cohort cells ------------------------------------

.gn_cov <- unique(gain_trends[, .(Study_area, n_cells_gain, n_cells)])
gn_cov_pool <- .gn_cov[, sum(n_cells_gain) / sum(n_cells)]
gn_cov_min  <- .gn_cov[, min(n_cells_gain / n_cells)]
.n10 <- unique(deg1_trends[, .(Study_area, n_cells_1deg)])

cat("=== 1-degree re-synthesis + cell-level gain factors ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  1-deg cells per aquifer         : min %d, median %d, max %d\n",
            min(.n10$n_cells_1deg), round(stats::median(.n10$n_cells_1deg)),
            max(.n10$n_cells_1deg)))
cat(sprintf("  pooled-median shift (1 deg)     : median |d| %.3f cm/yr, max %.3f\n",
            d1_shift_med, d1_shift_max))
cat(sprintf("  sign-paradoxical (1 deg)        : %d/%d (%.1f%%)   (headline %d/%d, %.1f%%)\n",
            rob_d1$n_par, rob_d1$n_aq, rob_d1$pct_par,
            rob_full$n_par, rob_full$n_aq, rob_full$pct_par))
cat(sprintf("  paradox turnover (1 deg)        : %d enter, %d leave\n",
            length(d1_enter), length(d1_leave)))
if (length(d1_enter)) cat("    enter:", paste(d1_enter, collapse = "; "), "\n")
if (length(d1_leave)) cat("    leave:", paste(d1_leave, collapse = "; "), "\n")
cat(sprintf("  R = 1 boundary (1 deg)          : %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]   (headline %.2f)\n",
            rob_d1$bnd, rob_d1$bnd_lo, rob_d1$bnd_hi, rob_full$bnd))
cat(sprintf("  gain coverage (cohort cells)    : %.1f%% finite (worst aquifer %.0f%%)\n",
            100 * gn_cov_pool, 100 * gn_cov_min))
cat(sprintf("  sign-paradoxical (gain)         : %d/%d (%.1f%%)\n",
            rob_gn$n_par, rob_gn$n_aq, rob_gn$pct_par))
cat(sprintf("  paradox turnover (gain)         : %d enter, %d leave\n",
            length(gn_enter), length(gn_leave)))
if (length(gn_enter)) cat("    enter:", paste(gn_enter, collapse = "; "), "\n")
if (length(gn_leave)) cat("    leave:", paste(gn_leave, collapse = "; "), "\n")
cat(sprintf("  R = 1 boundary (gain)           : %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
            rob_gn$bnd, rob_gn$bnd_lo, rob_gn$bnd_hi))

```{r gws-strata, dependson=c("robustness-subset-a","robustness-gws","robustness-stripes"), cache.extra=c(file.mtime(here::here("datasets","output","tier_a","gws_aux_trends.csv")), file.mtime(here::here("datasets","output","tier_a","gws_aux_trends_era5land.csv")), file.mtime(here::here("datasets","bibliometric","bibliometric_master_all.csv")))}

# GROUNDWATER-STRATIFIED PARADOX #############################################

# One table per recipe universe x endpoint (TWS / GWS-GLDAS / GWS-ERA5):
# paradox counts, the intersection X (paradox under both corrections), the
# three-stage intersection, and the R = 1 boundary via headline_subset.
gsx <- data.table::copy(per_recipe_trends)
gsx <- merge(gsx, gws_aux[, .(Study_area, centre, truncation,
                              g_aux = aux_trend_cmyr)],
             by = c("Study_area", "centre", "truncation"))
gsx <- merge(gsx, era5_aux[, .(Study_area, centre, truncation,
                               e_aux = aux_trend_cmyr)],
             by = c("Study_area", "centre", "truncation"))
gsx[, `:=`(gws_g = trend_cm_yr - g_aux, gws_e = trend_cm_yr - e_aux)]

# Universe flags: fully corrected (180), cleanest-damping half, and the
# literature-attested space recomputed on the ADJUDICATED corpus (the level
# is attested when >= 1 in-cohort own-SHM paper names it exactly).
gsx[, fully := c20_treatment == "replaced" & c30_treatment == "replaced" &
               geocenter == "GravIS" & gia_model != "none"]
.cmb <- unique(stripes[, .(centre, truncation, filter, stripe_idx)])
gsx <- merge(gsx, .cmb, by = c("centre", "truncation", "filter"))
gsx[, clean50 := stripe_idx <= stats::median(.cmb$stripe_idx)]
gsx[, combo90 := fully & clean50]
.own <- bib_strata <- data.table::fread(here::here(
  "datasets", "bibliometric", "bibliometric_master_all.csv"))[
  paper_category == "own-SHM" & as.character(in_cohort) %in% c("True", "TRUE")]
.cg <- function(x) { x0 <- tolower(x)
  data.table::fcase(grepl("caron", x0), "Caron_2018",
    grepl("ice.?6g", x0), "Peltier_ICE6G_D",
    grepl("ice.?5g|geruo|vm2", x0), "Geruo_ICE5G_VM2",
    x0 == "none", "none", default = x) }
.cf <- function(x) { x0 <- tolower(x)
  data.table::fcase(grepl("swenson", x0) & grepl("500", x0), "Swenson_G500",
    grepl("swenson", x0) & grepl("300", x0), "Swenson_G300", default = x) }
.n23 <- function(x) { x0 <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  data.table::fcase(grepl("replac", x0), "replaced",
    grepl("original", x0), "original", default = NA_character_) }
.ngo <- function(x) { x0 <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  data.table::fcase(grepl("none|not applied|no geo|omitted|n/a", x0), "none",
    grepl("swenson|sun|tn-?13|replac|geo-?cent|degree-?1|applied", x0), "GravIS",
    default = NA_character_) }
.rep <- list(centre = as.character(.own$centre),
  truncation = as.character(suppressWarnings(as.integer(.own$truncation))),
  filter = .cf(.own$filter), gia_model = .cg(.own$gia_model),
  c20_treatment = .n23(.own$c20), c30_treatment = .n23(.own$c30),
  geocenter = .ngo(.own$geocenter))
att_levels <- lapply(names(.rep), function(ax) {
  lv <- as.character(sort(unique(gsx[[ax]])))
  lv[vapply(lv, function(l) sum(.rep[[ax]] == l, na.rm = TRUE),
            integer(1)) > 0] })
names(att_levels) <- names(.rep)
gsx[, attested := TRUE]
for (.ax in names(att_levels)) if (length(att_levels[[.ax]]))
  gsx[!(as.character(get(.ax)) %in% att_levels[[.ax]]), attested := FALSE]
cat("Attested levels per axis:",
    paste(vapply(att_levels, length, integer(1)), collapse = "/"),
    "-> recipes:",
    nrow(unique(gsx[attested == TRUE, .(centre, truncation, filter, gia_model,
                                        c20_treatment, c30_treatment,
                                        geocenter)])), "\n\n")

# Preserve the attested recipe set explicitly; this export supersedes the
# pre-adjudication attested rows of nested_recipe_space_summary.csv.
.rk <- c("centre", "truncation", "filter", "gia_model",
         "c20_treatment", "c30_treatment", "geocenter")
attested_recipes <- unique(gsx[attested == TRUE, .rk, with = FALSE])
stopifnot(nrow(attested_recipes) == 126L,
          gsx[attested == TRUE, uniqueN(Study_area)] == 73L,
          nrow(gsx[attested == TRUE]) == 126L * 73L)
data.table::fwrite(attested_recipes, here::here(
  "datasets", "output", "robustness", "literature_attested_recipes.csv"))

.spans <- function(dt, col) dt[!is.na(get(col)),
  .(sp = (min(get(col)) < 0) & (max(get(col)) > 0)), by = Study_area]
.hsub <- function(dt, col) {
  d <- dt[, .(Study_area, trend_cm_yr = get(col))]
  data.table::setorder(d, Study_area)
  headline_subset(d)
}
# Cells with a published counterpart reuse the session object verbatim, so a
# quantity never carries two bootstrap CIs (the CI is resampling-order
# sensitive at the +-0.02 level).
.published <- list(
  full_t  = list(n_rec = 1920L, bnd = as.numeric(bnd_t1_loess$est),
                 bnd_lo = bnd_t1_loess$lo, bnd_hi = bnd_t1_loess$hi),
  full_g  = rob_gws,     full_e = rob_gws_e5,
  fully_t = rob_subA,  fully_g = rob_gws_subA,
  clean50_t = rob_st50)
gws_strata_tab <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(
  c("full", "fully", "clean50", "attested", "combo90"), function(u) {
    d <- if (u == "full") gsx else gsx[get(u) == TRUE]
    ht <- .published[[paste0(u, "_t")]]; if (is.null(ht)) ht <- .hsub(d, "trend_cm_yr")
    hg <- .published[[paste0(u, "_g")]]; if (is.null(hg)) hg <- .hsub(d, "gws_g")
    he <- .published[[paste0(u, "_e")]]; if (is.null(he)) he <- .hsub(d, "gws_e")
    m <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge(a, b, by = "Study_area"), list(
      .spans(d, "trend_cm_yr")[, .(Study_area, t = sp)],
      .spans(d, "gws_g")[, .(Study_area, g = sp)],
      .spans(d, "gws_e")[, .(Study_area, e = sp)]))
    data.table::data.table(universe = u, n_rec = ht$n_rec,
      tws = sum(m$t), gldas = sum(m$g), era5 = sum(m$e),
      X = sum(m$g & m$e), s3 = sum(m$t & m$g & m$e),
      bnd_t = ht$bnd, bnd_t_lo = ht$bnd_lo, bnd_t_hi = ht$bnd_hi,
      bnd_g = hg$bnd, bnd_g_lo = hg$bnd_lo, bnd_g_hi = hg$bnd_hi,
      bnd_e = he$bnd, bnd_e_lo = he$bnd_lo, bnd_e_hi = he$bnd_hi)
  }))

# Severity of the paradox: the minority-sign recipe share per aquifer, so the
# intersections can be reported at >= 5% and >= 10% support thresholds rather
# than the one-recipe zero-spanning criterion alone.
gws_severity <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(
  c("full", "fully", "clean50", "attested", "combo90"), function(u) {
    d <- if (u == "full") gsx else gsx[get(u) == TRUE]
    m <- d[!is.na(gws_g) & !is.na(gws_e), .(
      mt = min(mean(trend_cm_yr > 0), mean(trend_cm_yr < 0)),
      mg = min(mean(gws_g > 0), mean(gws_g < 0)),
      me = min(mean(gws_e > 0), mean(gws_e < 0))), by = Study_area]
    data.table::data.table(universe = u,
      X_any = m[mg > 0 & me > 0, .N],
      s3_any = m[mt > 0 & mg > 0 & me > 0, .N],
      X_05 = m[mg >= 0.05 & me >= 0.05, .N],
      s3_05 = m[mt >= 0.05 & mg >= 0.05 & me >= 0.05, .N],
      X_10 = m[mg >= 0.10 & me >= 0.10, .N],
      s3_10 = m[mt >= 0.10 & mg >= 0.10 & me >= 0.10, .N])
  }))

```{r tab-paradox-robustness, dependson=c("robustness-subset-a","robustness-lit-weights","robustness-gws","robustness-stripes","robustness-1deg-gain","gws-strata"), cache.extra=c(file.mtime(here::here("datasets","output","robustness","trend_window_sensitivity.csv")), file.mtime(here::here("datasets","output","robustness","trend_estimator_anchorcell.csv")), file.mtime(here::here("datasets","output","robustness","trend_estimator_global.csv.gz")))}

# ROBUSTNESS SUMMARY TABLE ###################################################
# One perturbation per row: paradox share + R = 1 boundary.
.nq <- 73L
.pc <- function(pct) sprintf("%d / %d (%.0f\\%%)", round(pct / 100 * .nq), .nq, pct)
.ws  <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output", "robustness",
                                     "trend_window_sensitivity.csv"))
.ws1 <- .ws[tier == "Tier 1 (73)"]
.go  <- .ws1[grepl("GRACE-only", window), spans_zero_pct]
.gfo <- .ws1[grepl("GRACE-FO",   window), spans_zero_pct]
.att <- gws_strata_tab[universe == "attested",
  .(n_recipes = n_rec, spans_zero_pct = 100 * tws / 73, r1_est = bnd_t,
    r1_lo = bnd_t_lo, r1_hi = bnd_t_hi)]
.bndfmt <- function(est, lo, hi) sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", est, lo, hi)

rob_tab <- data.table::data.table(
  Variant = c("Headline (full factorial, OLS)",
              "All null levels dropped",
              "Literature-attested levels only",
              "Literature-weighted ensemble",
              "Groundwater-corrected (GLDAS)",
              "Groundwater-corrected (ERA5-Land)",
              "Groundwater-corrected, null levels dropped",
              "Cleanest-damping half (stripe criterion)",
              "Re-synthesised on a 1$^{\\circ}$ grid",
              "Cell-level gain factors (TELLUS/CLM)",
              "GRACE-only window",
              "GRACE-FO window"),
  `Recipes / window` = c("1,920 / 2002--2025", "180 / 2002--2025",
                         sprintf("%d / 2002--2025", .att$n_recipes),
                         "1,920 weighted / 2002--2025",
                         "1,920 / 2002--2025", "1,920 / 2002--2025",
                         "180 / 2002--2025",
                         sprintf("%d / 2002--2025", rob_st50$n_rec),
                         "1,920 / 2002--2025", "1,920 / 2002--2025",
                         "1,920 / 2002--2017", "1,920 / 2018--2025"),
  `Sign-paradoxical` = c(.pc(rob_full$pct_par), .pc(rob_subA$pct_par),
                         .pc(.att$spans_zero_pct), .pc(lw_pct_par),
                         .pc(rob_gws$pct_par), .pc(rob_gws_e5$pct_par),
                         .pc(rob_gws_subA$pct_par), .pc(rob_st50$pct_par),
                         .pc(rob_d1$pct_par), .pc(rob_gn$pct_par),
                         .pc(.go), .pc(.gfo)),
  `$R=1$ boundary (cm yr$^{-1}$)` = c(
    .bndfmt(as.numeric(bnd_t1_loess$est), bnd_t1_loess$lo, bnd_t1_loess$hi),
    .bndfmt(rob_subA$bnd, rob_subA$bnd_lo, rob_subA$bnd_hi),
    .bndfmt(.att$r1_est, .att$r1_lo, .att$r1_hi),
    .bndfmt(lw_bnd$est, lw_bnd$lo, lw_bnd$hi),
    .bndfmt(rob_gws$bnd, rob_gws$bnd_lo, rob_gws$bnd_hi),
    .bndfmt(rob_gws_e5$bnd, rob_gws_e5$bnd_lo, rob_gws_e5$bnd_hi),
    .bndfmt(rob_gws_subA$bnd, rob_gws_subA$bnd_lo, rob_gws_subA$bnd_hi),
    .bndfmt(rob_st50$bnd, rob_st50$bnd_lo, rob_st50$bnd_hi),
    .bndfmt(rob_d1$bnd, rob_d1$bnd_lo, rob_d1$bnd_hi),
    .bndfmt(rob_gn$bnd, rob_gn$bnd_lo, rob_gn$bnd_hi),
    "--", "--"))

# Estimator invariance at one IGP grid cell (1,920 recipes).
.est <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output", "robustness",
                                     "trend_estimator_anchorcell.csv"))
.nflip <- .est[!((ols > 0) == (tsen > 0) & (ols > 0) == (seas > 0)), .N]
.r_ts  <- stats::cor(.est$ols, .est$tsen)
.mad   <- max(stats::median(abs(.est$ols - .est$tsen)),
              stats::median(abs(.est$ols - .est$seas)))

# Estimator invariance cohort-wide: every aquifer-recipe series refitted with
# Theil-Sen and with a seasonal least-squares model (code/estimator_global.py,
# run on the banked monthly series). The anchor cell shows no sign change at
# all; the cohort does, so the paradox counts, not the individual trends, are
# what the estimator leaves intact.
.estg <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output", "robustness",
                                      "trend_estimator_global.csv.gz"))
.estg[, agree := sign(ols) == sign(theilsen) & sign(ols) == sign(seasonal)]
est_glob <- list(
  n = nrow(.estg), agree = .estg[, mean(agree)],
  n_ts  = .estg[sign(ols) != sign(theilsen), .N],
  n_sea = .estg[sign(ols) != sign(seasonal), .N],
  par = vapply(c("ols", "theilsen", "seasonal"), function(e)
    .estg[, .(sp = min(get(e)) < 0 & max(get(e)) > 0), by = Study_area][, sum(sp)],
    integer(1)),
  n_aq_any = .estg[, .(a = all(agree)), by = Study_area][, sum(!a)])
cat(sprintf("Estimator invariance, cohort-wide: %s series, %.1f%% agree on sign; paradox %d (OLS) / %d (Theil-Sen) / %d (seasonal)\n",
    format(est_glob$n, big.mark = ","), 100 * est_glob$agree,
    est_glob$par[["ols"]], est_glob$par[["theilsen"]],
    est_glob$par[["seasonal"]]))

knitr::kable(rob_tab, booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, align = "llcc",
  caption = paste0("Robustness of the sign paradox and the detectability ",
    "boundary under perturbations of the recipe space (variant definitions ",
    "in the SM)."))

```{r span-sensitivity, dependson=c("load-tier-a","robustness-subset-a")}

# LOESS SPAN SENSITIVITY OF THE R = 1 BOUNDARY ###############################

.sp_aq <- per_recipe_trends[!is.na(trend_cm_yr),
                            .(med = stats::median(trend_cm_yr),
                              iqr = stats::IQR(trend_cm_yr)),
                            by = Study_area]
.sp_aq[, `:=`(x = abs(med), y = iqr / abs(med))]
for (s in c(0.5, 0.6, 0.75, 0.9, 1.0))
  cat(sprintf("  span %.2f: R = 1 boundary %.2f cm/yr\n",

```{r boundary-cluster, dependson=c("load-tier-a","robustness-subset-a")}

# CLUSTER BOOTSTRAP OF THE BOUNDARY ##########################################

# Several Tier-1 aquifers are sub-units of one broader system (the trailing
# parenthetical of Study_area). Resampling the 38 systems instead of the 73
# aquifers tests whether within-system dependence narrows the headline CI.
.caq <- per_recipe_trends[, .(med = stats::median(trend_cm_yr),
                              iqr = stats::IQR(trend_cm_yr)), by = Study_area]
.caq[, `:=`(x = abs(med), y = iqr / abs(med))]
.caq[, cluster := data.table::fifelse(grepl("\\)$", Study_area),
                    sub(".*\\(([^)]*)\\)$", "\\1", Study_area), Study_area)]
data.table::setorder(.caq, Study_area)
.ccl <- sort(unique(.caq$cluster))
set.seed(71)
.cbs <- replicate(2000L, {
  ci <- sample(.ccl, replace = TRUE)
  d <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(ci, function(k) .caq[cluster == k]))
  r1_loess_local(d$x, d$y)
})
.cbs <- .cbs[is.finite(.cbs)]
bnd_cluster <- list(est = r1_loess_local(.caq$x, .caq$y),
                    lo = stats::quantile(.cbs, 0.025),
                    hi = stats::quantile(.cbs, 0.975))
cat(sprintf("System-cluster bootstrap (%d clusters): R = 1 boundary %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
            length(.ccl), bnd_cluster$est, bnd_cluster$lo, bnd_cluster$hi))
stopifnot(length(.ccl) == 38L, round(bnd_cluster$est, 2) == 0.35,
          round(bnd_cluster$lo, 2) == 0.27, round(bnd_cluster$hi, 2) == 0.44)
```

# Groundwater-stratified paradox

Model-stratified groundwater analysis: sign-paradox prevalence per land-surface
correction, its intersection, the three-stage (TWS and both corrections)
intersection, and the attribution of preprocessing spread vs auxiliary-model
displacement -- across four recipe universes.

```{r gws-strata-report, dependson="gws-strata"}

# GROUNDWATER-STRATIFIED PARADOX -- RESULTS #################################
print(gws_strata_tab[, .(universe, n_rec, tws, gldas, era5, X, s3,
  bnd_tws   = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", bnd_t, bnd_t_lo, bnd_t_hi),
  bnd_gldas = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", bnd_g, bnd_g_lo, bnd_g_hi),
  bnd_era5  = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", bnd_e, bnd_e_lo, bnd_e_hi))])

# Minority-sign support thresholds --------------------------------------------
cat("\n")
print(gws_severity)

# Five-category stratification (full ensemble) -------------------------------
.mst <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge(a, b, by = "Study_area"), list(
  .spans(gsx, "gws_g")[, .(Study_area, g = sp)],
  .spans(gsx, "gws_e")[, .(Study_area, e = sp)],
  gsx[!is.na(gws_g), .(med_g = stats::median(gws_g),
                       iqr_g = stats::IQR(gws_g)), by = Study_area],
  gsx[!is.na(gws_e), .(med_e = stats::median(gws_e),
                       iqr_e = stats::IQR(gws_e)), by = Study_area]))
.mst[, cat := data.table::fcase(
  g & e, "robust preprocessing paradox",
  xor(g, e), "model-sensitive paradox",
  !g & !e & sign(med_g) != sign(med_e), "auxiliary-model sign reversal",
  !g & !e & (iqr_g < abs(med_g)) & (iqr_e < abs(med_e)), "robust sign consensus",
  default = "weak consensus")]
gws_categories <- .mst[, .N, keyby = cat]
cat("\n")
print(gws_categories)

# Paired model-induced sign flips + attribution ------------------------------
gws_pairflip <- gsx[!is.na(gws_g) & !is.na(gws_e),
  .(flip = mean(sign(gws_g) != sign(gws_e))), by = Study_area]
cat(sprintf("\nPaired GLDAS vs ERA5 recipe sign flips: median %.3f, range %.3f-%.3f; > 5%%: %d aquifers, > 10%%: %d\n",
    stats::median(gws_pairflip$flip), min(gws_pairflip$flip),
    max(gws_pairflip$flip), sum(gws_pairflip$flip > 0.05),
    sum(gws_pairflip$flip > 0.10)))
gws_attrib <- gsx[!is.na(gws_g) & !is.na(gws_e),
  .(iqr_g = stats::IQR(gws_g), iqr_e = stats::IQR(gws_e),
    disp = abs(stats::median(gws_g) - stats::median(gws_e))), by = Study_area]
cat(sprintf("Attribution: median within-model IQR %.2f (GLDAS) / %.2f (ERA5) vs median between-model displacement %.2f cm/yr\n",
    stats::median(gws_attrib$iqr_g), stats::median(gws_attrib$iqr_e),
    stats::median(gws_attrib$disp)))

  sp_t = min(trend_cm_yr) < 0 & max(trend_cm_yr) > 0,
  sp_g = min(gws_g) < 0 & max(gws_g) > 0,

  mar_g = min(-min(gws_g), max(gws_g)),
  mar_e = min(-min(gws_e), max(gws_e)),
  m05_t = min(-stats::quantile(trend_cm_yr, 0.05),

  m05_g = min(-stats::quantile(gws_g, 0.05), stats::quantile(gws_g, 0.95)),
  m05_e = min(-stats::quantile(gws_e, 0.05), stats::quantile(gws_e, 0.95))),
  by = Study_area]

             by = "Study_area")

    X_low010 = X[bound_cmyr < 0.10, .N], s3_low010 = s3[bound_cmyr < 0.10, .N],
    X_immune = X[bound_cmyr < pmin(mar_g, mar_e), .N],
    s3_immune = s3[bound_cmyr < pmin(mar_t, mar_g, mar_e), .N],
    X_immune05 = X[bound_cmyr < pmin(m05_g, m05_e), .N],
    s3_immune05 = s3[bound_cmyr < pmin(m05_t, m05_g, m05_e), .N])
}))
print(gws_screen)

```{r revision-robustness, dependson=c("load-tier-a","boundary-ci")}

# FILTER-FAMILY WEIGHTING AND RESOLUTION-SAFE COHORTS #########################

# Each filter family (5 DDK, 3 Gaussian, 2 destriped levels) weighted equally,
# so no family's level count sets its share of the ensemble.
per_recipe_trends[, .fam := data.table::fifelse(grepl("^DDK", filter), "ddk",
                  data.table::fifelse(grepl("^Swenson", filter), "swenson",
                                      "gaussian"))]
per_recipe_trends[, .w := 1 / (data.table::uniqueN(filter) * 3), by = .fam]
.wq <- function(x, w, p) {
  o <- order(x)
  stats::approx(cumsum(w[o]) / sum(w), x[o], xout = p, rule = 2)$y
}
fam_agg <- per_recipe_trends[!is.na(trend_cm_yr), .(
  med_u = stats::median(trend_cm_yr),
  med_w = .wq(trend_cm_yr, .w, 0.5),
  iqr_w = .wq(trend_cm_yr, .w, 0.75) - .wq(trend_cm_yr, .w, 0.25),
  min_w = pmin(sum(.w * (trend_cm_yr < 0)), sum(.w * (trend_cm_yr > 0))) /
    sum(.w)), by = Study_area]
bnd_fam <- detectability_boundary_fun(abs(fam_agg$med_w),
                                      fam_agg$iqr_w / abs(fam_agg$med_w))
stopifnot(round(bnd_fam$est, 2) == 0.34, round(bnd_fam$lo, 2) == 0.28,
          round(bnd_fam$hi, 2) == 0.41,
          fam_agg[sign(med_w) != sign(med_u), .N] == 2L,
          fam_agg[min_w >= 0.05, .N] == 48L)
cat(sprintf("family-equal boundary %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]; median sign flips 2; >=5%% support 48\n",
            bnd_fam$est, bnd_fam$lo, bnd_fam$hi))

# Paradox share on the resolution-safe cohorts (>= 150k / >= 200k km2) --------
.spans <- per_recipe_trends[!is.na(trend_cm_yr),
  .(spans = min(trend_cm_yr) < 0 & max(trend_cm_yr) > 0), by = Study_area]
.spans <- merge(.spans, cohort[, .(Study_area, area_km2)], by = "Study_area")
stopifnot(.spans[area_km2 >= 1.5e5, sum(spans)] == 11L,
          .spans[area_km2 >= 1.5e5, .N] == 15L,
          .spans[area_km2 >= 2.0e5, sum(spans)] == 8L,
          .spans[area_km2 >= 2.0e5, .N] == 11L)
cat("paradox on resolution-safe cohorts: 11/15 (>=150k), 8/11 (>=200k)\n")
