```{r tier2-stats, dependson="load-tier-a-276"}

# TWO-TIER COMPARISON STATISTICS ##############################################

# Bootstrap Spearman helper -- seed and n_boot match the Section 2 gradient
# chunk so the Tier-1 column reproduces the manuscript headline exactly.
boot_rho_276 <- function(x, y, n_boot = 2000L, seed = 43L) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
  rho <- stats::cor(x, y, method = "spearman")
  set.seed(seed)
  bs <- replicate(n_boot, {
    i <- sample.int(length(x), replace = TRUE)
    suppressWarnings(stats::cor(x[i], y[i], method = "spearman"))
  })
  ci <- stats::quantile(bs, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  list(rho = rho, lo = ci[[1L]], hi = ci[[2L]], n = length(x))
}

# (1) Gradient regression -- Tier 1 vs Tier 1+2
grad_t1 <- boot_rho_276(gradient_data_276[tier == "tier1", abs_GRACE_trend],
                        gradient_data_276[tier == "tier1", dominance_R])
grad_ta <- boot_rho_276(gradient_data_276$abs_GRACE_trend,
                        gradient_data_276$dominance_R)

# (2) Sign-paradox census -- aquifers whose 1,920 recipes span both signs
sp_t1 <- sign_paradox_276[tier == "tier1"]
sp_t2 <- sign_paradox_276[tier == "tier2"]
n_para_t1 <- sum(sp_t1$spans_zero);            frac_para_t1 <- mean(sp_t1$spans_zero)
n_para_t2 <- sum(sp_t2$spans_zero);            frac_para_t2 <- mean(sp_t2$spans_zero)
n_para_ta <- sum(sign_paradox_276$spans_zero); frac_para_ta <- mean(sign_paradox_276$spans_zero)

# Leakage null scales as area^-0.5; intrinsic spread ~ area^0.
.boot_b <- function(y, area, n_boot = 5000L, seed = 44L) {
  ok <- is.finite(y) & is.finite(area) & y > 0 & area > 0
  la <- log10(area[ok]); ly <- log10(y[ok])
  b  <- stats::coef(stats::lm(ly ~ la))[[2L]]
  set.seed(seed)
  bs <- replicate(n_boot, {
    i <- sample.int(length(la), replace = TRUE)
    stats::coef(stats::lm(ly[i] ~ la[i]))[[2L]]
  })
  ci <- stats::quantile(bs, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  list(b = b, lo = ci[[1L]], hi = ci[[2L]])
}
bfit_iqr <- .boot_b(size_check_276$recipe_iqr,      size_check_276$area_km2)
bfit_fp  <- .boot_b(size_check_276$sd_footprint,    size_check_276$area_km2)
bfit_nf  <- .boot_b(size_check_276$sd_nonfootprint, size_check_276$area_km2)
b_iqr <- bfit_iqr$b; b_fp <- bfit_fp$b; b_nf <- bfit_nf$b
iqr_t1 <- stats::median(size_check_276[tier == "tier1", recipe_iqr], na.rm = TRUE)
iqr_t2 <- stats::median(size_check_276[tier == "tier2", recipe_iqr], na.rm = TRUE)
mw_iqr <- suppressWarnings(stats::wilcox.test(
  size_check_276[tier == "tier1", recipe_iqr],
  size_check_276[tier == "tier2", recipe_iqr]))$p.value

# (4) Variance decomposition -- mean per-aquifer main-effect fraction
vd_main <- variance_decomp_276[term_type == "main"]
vd_t1 <- vd_main[tier == "tier1", .(frac = mean(frac, na.rm = TRUE)), by = term]
vd_ta <- vd_main[, .(frac = mean(frac, na.rm = TRUE)), by = term]
data.table::setorder(vd_t1, -frac)
data.table::setorder(vd_ta, -frac)

cat("=== Two-tier comparison: Tier 1 (n=73) vs Tier 1+2 (n=276) ===\n")
cat("\n(1) GRADIENT  Spearman rho(|GRACE trend|, dominance R)\n")
cat(sprintf("    Tier 1   : %+.3f  95%% CI [%+.3f, %+.3f]  (n=%d)\n",
            grad_t1$rho, grad_t1$lo, grad_t1$hi, grad_t1$n))
cat(sprintf("    Tier 1+2 : %+.3f  95%% CI [%+.3f, %+.3f]  (n=%d)\n",
            grad_ta$rho, grad_ta$lo, grad_ta$hi, grad_ta$n))
cat("\n(2) SIGN PARADOX  aquifers whose 1,920 recipes span both signs\n")
cat(sprintf("    Tier 1   : %d of %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            n_para_t1, nrow(sp_t1), 100 * frac_para_t1))
cat(sprintf("    Tier 2   : %d of %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            n_para_t2, nrow(sp_t2), 100 * frac_para_t2))
cat(sprintf("    Tier 1+2 : %d of %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            n_para_ta, nrow(sign_paradox_276), 100 * frac_para_ta))
cat("\n(3) LINCHPIN  recipe spread vs aquifer area (log-log OLS exponent b; leakage predicts -0.50)\n")
cat(sprintf("    total recipe IQR : b = %+.3f  95%% CI [%+.3f, %+.3f]\n",
            bfit_iqr$b, bfit_iqr$lo, bfit_iqr$hi))
cat(sprintf("    footprint axes   : b = %+.3f  95%% CI [%+.3f, %+.3f]  (filter+truncation -- CAN leak)\n",
            bfit_fp$b, bfit_fp$lo, bfit_fp$hi))
cat(sprintf("    non-footprint SD : b = %+.3f  95%% CI [%+.3f, %+.3f]  (cannot leak by construction)\n",
            bfit_nf$b, bfit_nf$lo, bfit_nf$hi))
cat(sprintf("    median recipe IQR: Tier 1 %.3f cm/yr, Tier 2 %.3f cm/yr;  Mann-Whitney p = %.3g\n",
            iqr_t1, iqr_t2, mw_iqr))
cat("\n(4) VARIANCE DECOMPOSITION  mean per-aquifer main-effect fraction\n")
cat("    axis             Tier 1   Tier 1+2\n")
for (trm in vd_t1$term)
  cat(sprintf("    %-15s  %.3f    %.3f\n", trm,
              vd_t1[term == trm, frac], vd_ta[term == trm, frac]))
cat("\nThe Tier-1 column reproduces the Section 1-2 manuscript values;\n")
cat("the Tier 1+2 column is the robustness layer.\n")
```

# FIG T1: RECIPE VARIANCE VS AQUIFER SIZE -- THE LEAKAGE TEST #################

sc <- data.table::copy(size_check_276)
res_elem_km2 <- 110000
tier_cols_t2 <- c("Tier 1" = "#3a78c2", "Tier 2" = "#d98d30")

# Centroid-anchored leakage-null reference (slope -0.5 in log-log space).
null_line_t2 <- function(yv) {
  d <- sc[is.finite(get(yv)) & get(yv) > 0]
  cx <- mean(log10(d$area_km2)); cy <- mean(log10(d[[yv]]))
  ax <- range(d$area_km2)
  data.table::data.table(area_km2 = ax,
                         y = 10^(cy - 0.5 * (log10(ax) - cx)))
}

scatter_t2 <- function(yv, ylab) {
  d <- sc[is.finite(get(yv)) & get(yv) > 0]
  ggplot(d, aes(area_km2, get(yv))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = res_elem_km2, linetype = "dotted",
               linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey55") +
    geom_line(data = null_line_t2(yv), aes(area_km2, y),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype = "dashed",
              linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey45") +
    geom_point(aes(colour = tier_lab), size = 0.9, alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE,
                colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5, fill = "grey80") +
    scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = unname(tier_cols_t2), name = NULL) +
    labs(x = expression(paste("aquifer area  (km"^2, ", log scale)")),
         y = ylab) +
    theme_AP() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

# Panel (a): footprint axes that COULD leak (filter + truncation degree).
pTa <- scatter_t2("sd_footprint",
                  expression(paste("footprint-axis SD  (cm yr"^-1, ")"))) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.99, 0.99), legend.justification = c(1, 1),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "lines"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6))
# Panel (b): non-footprint axes that CANNOT leak (centre, GIA, C20/C30, geocentre).
pTb <- scatter_t2("sd_nonfootprint",
                  expression(paste("non-footprint SD  (cm yr"^-1, ")")))

# Panel (c): independent mask-sensitivity test.
lk <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output", "robustness",
                                    "leakage_summary.csv"))
lk[, mask_version := factor(mask_version,
                            levels = c("eroded", "original", "buffered"))]
pTc <- ggplot(lk, aes(mask_version, pct_spans_zero)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "#b5543a", colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", pct_spans_zero)),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 2.1, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% aquifers sign-paradoxical") +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5))

cowplot::plot_grid(pTa, pTb, pTc, nrow = 1, labels = "auto")

# LEAKAGE OF THE MEDIAN -- EXTERIOR-RING DIAGNOSTIC ##########################
# From the eroded/original/buffered mask runs: per-aquifer exterior-ring
# trend, the median shift between the eroded interior and the original
# polygon.

lmk <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output", "robustness",
                                    "leakage_mask_sensitivity.csv"))
lmk[, spans_zero := as.character(spans_zero) %chin% c("True", "TRUE")]

stopifnot(nrow(lmw73) == 73L)

lmw73[, ring_trend := (n_cells_buffered * median_trend_buffered -
                         n_cells_original * median_trend_original) /
        pmax(n_cells_buffered - n_cells_original, 1L)]
lmw73[, ring_contrast := ring_trend - median_trend_original]
lmw73[, med_shift_int := median_trend_eroded - median_trend_original]

        sign(median_trend_eroded) != sign(median_trend_original)]

.exemplars <- c("Jiangsu Coastal Plain (Huaihe River Basin)",
                "Southern Riverine Plains (Murray Basin)",
                "Eastside Lower Indus Valley (Indus Basin)",
                "Eastside Middle Indus Plain (Indus Basin)",

                "Lower Liaohe River Plain (Liaohe River Basin)")

cat("=== Leakage of the median: exterior-ring diagnostic (73 aquifers) ===\n")

            stats::median(abs(lmw73$ring_contrast), na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  median |interior shift| (eroded)  : %.3f cm/yr\n",
            stats::median(abs(lmw73$med_shift_int), na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  verdict changes eroded vs original: %d of 73\n",
            sum(lmw73$sign_change_int, na.rm = TRUE)))
if (any(lmw73$sign_change_int, na.rm = TRUE))
  cat("    ", paste(lmw73[sign_change_int == TRUE, Study_area],
                    collapse = "; "), "\n")

  order(-abs(ring_contrast))][1:8, .(
    Study_area = substr(Study_area, 1, 48),
    t_int = round(median_trend_original, 2),
    t_ring = round(ring_trend, 2),
    contrast = round(ring_contrast, 2))])
cat("\n  named coastal / glacier-adjacent exemplars:\n")

  Study_area = substr(Study_area, 1, 48),
  t_int = round(median_trend_original, 2),
  t_ring = round(ring_trend, 2),
  contrast = round(ring_contrast, 2),
  rank = rank(-abs(lmw73$ring_contrast))[match(Study_area,

    "Northern High Plains (High Plains)",
    paste0("Amazonas Basin and Alter de Chao Aquifer System ",
           "(Amazon Aquifer System)")),
  short_label = c("Guarani", "Karoo", "Murray", "Ogallala", "Amazon"))

rho_lab_t2 <- deparse1(substitute(
  atop("Tier 1 (" * italic(n) == nt1 * "):" ~ rho == rt1 ~
         "[" * lo1 * ", " * hi1 * "]",
       "Tier 1+2 (" * italic(n) == nta * "):" ~ rho == rta ~
         "[" * loa * ", " * hia * "]"),
  list(nt1 = grad_t1$n,
       rt1 = sprintf("%+.2f", grad_t1$rho),
       lo1 = sprintf("%+.2f", grad_t1$lo),
       hi1 = sprintf("%+.2f", grad_t1$hi),
       nta = grad_ta$n,
       rta = sprintf("%+.2f", grad_ta$rho),
       loa = sprintf("%+.2f", grad_ta$lo),
       hia = sprintf("%+.2f", grad_ta$hi))))

# Forest-plot CI bars for the two co-primary boundary metrics on the full
# 276-aquifer cohort.
ci_bars_t2 <- data.table::data.table(
  est = c(bnd_ta_loess$est, bnd_ta_sa095_loess$est),
  lo  = c(bnd_ta_loess$lo,  bnd_ta_sa095_loess$lo),
  hi  = c(bnd_ta_loess$hi,  bnd_ta_sa095_loess$hi),
  y   = c(280,              450),
  col = c("#c8730f",        "#5a2469"))
ci_bars_t2[, lab := sprintf("%s: %.2f",
                            c("R = 1", "sign-agreement = 0.95"), est)]
ci_bars_t2[, cap_lo := y * 0.85]
ci_bars_t2[, cap_hi := y * 1.18]
ci_bars_t2[, x_label := min(lo) * 0.85]

plot_gradient_t2 <- ggplot(gdt, aes(abs_GRACE_trend, dominance_R)) +
  # Two co-primary detectability-boundary bands for the full 276-aquifer
  # cohort.
  annotate("rect", xmin = bnd_ta_loess$lo, xmax = bnd_ta_loess$hi,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#e08214", alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = bnd_ta_loess$est, colour = "#c8730f",
             linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = bnd_ta_sa095_loess$lo, xmax = bnd_ta_sa095_loess$hi,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#7b3294", alpha = 0.40) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = bnd_ta_sa095_loess$est, colour = "#5a2469",
             linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "longdash") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3,
             colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = climate_zone, shape = tier_lab, size = tier_lab),
             alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(data = gdt[tier == "tier1"], method = "loess", se = FALSE,
              colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6, formula = y ~ x) +
  geom_smooth(data = gdt, method = "loess", se = FALSE,
              colour = "grey35", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "dashed",
              formula = y ~ x) +
  geom_segment(data = ci_bars_t2,
               aes(x = lo, xend = hi, y = y, yend = y),
               colour = ci_bars_t2$col, linewidth = 0.7,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = ci_bars_t2,
               aes(x = lo, xend = lo, y = cap_lo, yend = cap_hi),
               colour = ci_bars_t2$col, linewidth = 0.5,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = ci_bars_t2,
               aes(x = hi, xend = hi, y = cap_lo, yend = cap_hi),
               colour = ci_bars_t2$col, linewidth = 0.5,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = ci_bars_t2,
             aes(x = est, y = y),
             colour = ci_bars_t2$col, size = 2.1,
             inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = ci_bars_t2,
            aes(x = x_label, y = y, label = lab),
            colour = ci_bars_t2$col, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5,
            size = 2.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = merge(gdt, lab_consensus, by = "Study_area"),
    aes(label = short_label), size = 2.0, max.overlaps = 20,
    box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 0.3, segment.size = 0.3,
    segment.colour = "grey45", min.segment.length = 0,
    fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.7), colour = "black",
    label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.1, "lines"),
    label.r = unit(0.1, "lines")) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = merge(gdt, lab_paradox, by = "Study_area"),
    aes(label = short_label), size = 2.0, max.overlaps = 20,
    box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 0.3, segment.size = 0.3,
    segment.colour = "#d35400", min.segment.length = 0,
    fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.7), colour = "#d35400",
    fontface = "bold", label.size = 0,
    label.padding = unit(0.1, "lines"), label.r = unit(0.1, "lines")) +
  annotate("label", x = 0.0011, y = 0.32, label = rho_lab_t2,
           hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 2.0,
           fill = "white", alpha = 0.85, parse = TRUE) +
  scale_x_log10() +

       y = expression(paste("R = IQR / |median|"))) +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# Origin of the disagreement

Variance decomposition, one-axis-at-a-time reversals and the mascon comparison.

```{r mechanism-axis-summary, dependson="load-tier-a"}

# PER-AXIS MARGINAL SKILL #####################################################

# For each preprocessing axis, mean aquifer-trend skill (skill = -rho_raw,
# higher = better) and IQR across all recipes at every level.
axis_cols <- c("centre", "truncation", "filter", "gia_model",
                "c20_treatment", "c30_treatment", "geocenter")

cat("\n=== Per-axis marginal aquifer-trend skill (-Spearman rho vs Jasechko) ===\n")
for (ax in axis_cols) {
  tab <- per_recipe_skill[, .(
    mean_skill = mean(skill_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_skill = stats::IQR(skill_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = .N),
    by = ax]
  data.table::setorder(tab, -mean_skill)
  cat(sprintf("\n-- axis: %s --\n", ax))
  print(tab)
}
```

```{r aquifer-decomp, dependson="load-tier-a"}

# PER-AQUIFER VARIANCE DECOMPOSITION ##########################################

# Decompose each aquifer's 1,920-recipe trend vector into 7 main-effect SS,
# 21 pairwise-interaction SS, plus a higher-order residual; report each as a
# share of total variance.
decomp_long <- aquifer_variance_decomp_fun(per_recipe_trends)

decomp_long <- merge(
  decomp_long,
  cohort_full[, .(Study_area, climate_zone)],
  by = "Study_area", all.x = TRUE)

# Self-validation report ------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== Decomposition coverage check ===\n")
sums_per_aq <- decomp_long[, .(total = sum(frac)), by = Study_area]
cat(sprintf("  per-aquifer fraction sum: median = %.3f, range [%.3f, %.3f]\n",
              stats::median(sums_per_aq$total),
              min(sums_per_aq$total), max(sums_per_aq$total)))

cat("\n=== Mean main-effect fraction across aquifers ===\n")
print(decomp_long[term_type == "main",
                    .(mean_frac = round(mean(frac), 3),
                       q25 = round(stats::quantile(frac, 0.25), 3),
                       q75 = round(stats::quantile(frac, 0.75), 3)),
                    by = term][order(-mean_frac)])

cat("\n=== Top-10 pairwise interactions (mean across aquifers) ===\n")
print(decomp_long[term_type == "interaction",
                    .(mean_frac = round(mean(frac), 3),
                       q25 = round(stats::quantile(frac, 0.25), 3),
                       q75 = round(stats::quantile(frac, 0.75), 3)),
                    by = .(term, ax1, ax2)][order(-mean_frac)][1:10])

cat("\n=== Residual (3-way and higher) ===\n")
res_summary <- decomp_long[term_type == "residual",
                             .(mean_frac = round(mean(frac), 3),
                                q25 = round(stats::quantile(frac, 0.25), 3),
                                q75 = round(stats::quantile(frac, 0.75), 3))]
print(res_summary)

# Sub-section: one-at-a-time sign-reversal rate -------------------------------

# For each axis, hold the other six fixed and ask whether toggling this axis
# alone flips the sign of the aquifer trend. The block flip-rate is the
# fraction of [aquifer x other-six-axes] blocks whose sign is not constant.
axes_blk <- c("filter", "gia_model", "geocenter", "centre", "truncation",
               "c20_treatment", "c30_treatment")
block_tab_73 <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(axes_blk, function(a) {
  other <- setdiff(axes_blk, a)
  bl <- per_recipe_trends[, .(flips = any(trend_cm_yr > 0) &
                                 any(trend_cm_yr < 0)),
                           by = c("Study_area", other)]
  data.table::data.table(
    axis = a, levels = data.table::uniqueN(per_recipe_trends[[a]]),
    n_blocks = nrow(bl), flip_rate = round(100 * mean(bl$flips), 1))
}))
data.table::setorder(block_tab_73, -flip_rate)

cat("\n=== Block sign-flip rate per axis ===\n")
print(block_tab_73)
```

```{r fig-disagreement, dependson=c("prelim","load-tier-a","aquifer-decomp"), cache.extra=file.mtime(here::here("datasets","output","robustness","mascon_vs_recipe_ensemble.csv")), fig.width=5.5, fig.height=1.5}

# COMPOSITE: WHERE THE DISAGREEMENT COMES FROM (73-aquifer Tier-1 cohort) ######
# Panels (a) and (b) read the objects the assertion block pins, so the figure
# and the published numbers cannot diverge.

# Shared axis order (variance share, descending) so panels (a) and (b) pair
# row for row.
ax_short <- c(filter = "filter", gia_model = "GIA", geocenter = "geocentre",
              centre = "centre", truncation = "truncation",
              c20_treatment = "C20", c30_treatment = "C30")

# --- Panel (a): cross-recipe trend-variance share per axis -------------------
va_d <- decomp_long[term_type == "main",
                    .(frac = mean(frac, na.rm = TRUE)), by = term]
va_d[, axis := ax_short[term]]
data.table::setorder(va_d, -frac)
ax_levels <- rev(va_d$axis)              # ascending -> filter on top
va_d[, axis := factor(axis, levels = ax_levels)]

p_var <- ggplot(va_d, aes(frac, axis)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4a6680", width = 0.72) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(frac, accuracy = 1)),
            hjust = -0.15, size = 1.95, colour = "grey25") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.28)), 
                     breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 3)) +
  labs(x = "variance share", y = NULL) +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.4),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 6.8))

# --- Panel (b): per-axis sign-reversal power (block flip-rate) ---------------
bl_d <- data.table::copy(block_tab_73)
bl_d[, axis := factor(ax_short[axis], levels = ax_levels)]
p_flip <- ggplot(bl_d, aes(flip_rate / 100, axis)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#b5543a", width = 0.72) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(flip_rate / 100, accuracy = 1)),
            hjust = -0.15, size = 1.95, colour = "grey25") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.28)), 
                     breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 2)) +
  labs(x = "sign-flip rate", y = "") +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 6.8))

# --- Panel (c): mascons vs the recipe ensemble ------------------------------
B_det <- 0.35                              # headline detectability boundary
mv_d <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output", "robustness",
                                     "mascon_vs_recipe_ensemble.csv"))
mv_d <- mv_d[Study_area %chin% cohort$Study_area]   # Tier-1 cohort
para_d <- mv_d[l2_spans_zero == TRUE]      # 56 recipe-sign-paradoxical aquifers
para_d[, m_unanimous := m_sign_agree == 1]   # the three mascons agree among themselves
n_ag <- sum(para_d$m_unanimous); n_sp <- sum(!para_d$m_unanimous)
para_d[, abs_l2 := abs(l2_median)]
para_d[, mascon_cat := factor(
  data.table::fifelse(m_unanimous, sprintf("mascons agree (%d)", n_ag),
                      sprintf("mascons split (%d)", n_sp)),
  levels = c(sprintf("mascons split (%d)", n_sp),
             sprintf("mascons agree (%d)", n_ag)))]
para_d[, loc := factor(data.table::fifelse(abs_l2 < B_det, "below boundary",
                                           "above boundary"),
                       levels = c("below boundary", "above boundary"))]
set.seed(7L)
p_masc <- ggplot(para_d, aes(abs_l2, mascon_cat)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = B_det, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3,
             colour = "grey45") +
  annotate("text", x = B_det * 0.92, y = 1.5, label = "0.35",
           angle = 90, size = 1.7, colour = "grey45", vjust = 0) +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = loc), height = 0.24, width = 0,
              size = 0.7, alpha = 0.75, shape = 16) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.55, 0.55))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("below boundary" = "#c0653a",
                                 "above boundary" = "#3a78c2"),
                      name = NULL) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 1.5, alpha = 1))) +
  labs(x = expression(paste("|recipe-median trend|  (cm yr"^-1, ")")),
       y = NULL) +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.2),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 6.5),
        legend.position = c(0.2, 0.5),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 5.4),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.35, "lines"),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(1, "pt"))

ab <- cowplot::plot_grid(p_var, p_flip, ncol = 2,
                         rel_widths = c(0.56, 0.44), labels = c("a", "b"),
                         label_size = 11)
cowplot::plot_grid(ab, p_masc, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.52, 0.48),
                   labels = c("", "c"), label_size = 11)

# How many aquifers does the 3-mascon cohort itself disagree on?

```{r corpus-recipe-prevalence, cache.extra=file.mtime(here::here("datasets","bibliometric","bibliometric_master_all.csv"))}

# CORPUS-WIDE RECIPE-LEVEL PREVALENCE -- DEFENSIBILITY OF THE NULL LEVELS #####
# Per axis over own-SHM papers: unreported count, explicit do-nothing count,
# and out-of-factorial count.

.prev <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "bibliometric",
                                      "bibliometric_master_all.csv"))
.prev <- unique(.prev[paper_category == "own-SHM"], by = "oa_id")
n_prev <- nrow(.prev)

.unstated <- function(x) {
  v <- trimws(as.character(x))
  is.na(v) | tolower(v) %in% c("", "unclear", "na", "n/a", "none reported",
    "not reported", "not specified", "unspecified", "not stated")
}
.canon_gia_prev <- function(x) {
  x0 <- tolower(x)
  data.table::fcase(
    grepl("caron", x0),                   "Caron_2018",
    grepl("ice.?6g|ice6g", x0),           "Peltier_ICE6G_D",
    grepl("ice.?5g|ice5g|geruo|vm2", x0), "Geruo_ICE5G_VM2",
    x0 == "none",                         "none",
    default = x)
}
.canon_filter_prev <- function(x) {
  x0 <- tolower(x)
  data.table::fcase(
    grepl("swenson", x0) & grepl("500", x0), "Swenson_G500",
    grepl("swenson", x0) & grepl("300", x0), "Swenson_G300",
    default = x)
}
.prev[, gia_canon    := .canon_gia_prev(gia_model)]
.prev[, filter_canon := .canon_filter_prev(filter)]

prev_axes <- c("centre", "truncation", "filter", "gia_model",
               "c20", "c30", "geocenter")
prev_unrep_n   <- sapply(prev_axes, function(ax) sum(.unstated(.prev[[ax]])))
prev_unrep_pct <- 100 * prev_unrep_n / n_prev

# Explicit do-nothing statements (the null as documented, not just
# non-excludable, practice).
n_gia_explicit_none <- .prev[!.unstated(gia_model) &
                             tolower(trimws(gia_model)) == "none", .N]
n_c20_explicit_orig <- .prev[!.unstated(c20) &
  grepl("original|not replaced|kept|retain", tolower(c20)), .N]
n_geo_explicit_none <- .prev[!.unstated(geocenter) &
  grepl("^none$|not applied|not restored|no correction", tolower(geocenter)), .N]
n_filter_explicit_none <- .prev[!.unstated(filter) &
                                tolower(trimws(filter)) == "none", .N]

# Levels named OUTSIDE the 1,920-recipe factorial.
.grid_filters <- c("G300", "G400", "G500", "Swenson_G300", "Swenson_G500",
                   "DDK2", "DDK3", "DDK5", "DDK7", "DDK8")
.grid_gia     <- c("Geruo_ICE5G_VM2", "Caron_2018", "Peltier_ICE6G_D", "none")
n_out_filter <- .prev[!.unstated(filter) &
                      !filter_canon %in% .grid_filters, .N]
n_out_gia    <- .prev[!.unstated(gia_model) &
                      !gia_canon %in% .grid_gia, .N]
n_out_centre <- .prev[grepl("grgs|itsg|tongji|gsfc|cnes|hust|whu",
                            tolower(centre)), .N]
n_out_trunc  <- .prev[!.unstated(truncation) &
  !trimws(as.character(truncation)) %in% c("60", "96"), .N]

cat("=== Corpus-wide recipe-level prevalence, own-SHM unique papers (n=",
    n_prev, ") ===\n\n", sep = "")
cat("Axis unreported (null level non-excludable from the stated method):\n")
for (ax in prev_axes)
  cat(sprintf("  %-12s : %3d / %d (%5.1f%%)\n",
              ax, prev_unrep_n[[ax]], n_prev, prev_unrep_pct[[ax]]))
cat("\nExplicit do-nothing statements:\n")
cat(sprintf("  GIA = none (e.g. Yi & Sun 2016)     : %d\n", n_gia_explicit_none))
cat(sprintf("  C20 kept original                   : %d\n", n_c20_explicit_orig))
cat(sprintf("  geocentre not restored              : %d\n", n_geo_explicit_none))
cat(sprintf("  no smoothing filter                 : %d\n", n_filter_explicit_none))
cat("\nLevels named OUTSIDE the 1,920-recipe factorial (under-sampling):\n")
cat(sprintf("  centre  (GRGS/ITSG/Tongji/GSFC/...) : %d papers\n", n_out_centre))
cat(sprintf("  truncation (not 60/96)              : %d papers\n", n_out_trunc))
cat(sprintf("  filter  (fan, P*M*, G200-G1000, ...) : %d papers\n", n_out_filter))
cat(sprintf("  GIA model (Paulson 2007, GNSS, ...) : %d papers\n", n_out_gia))
cat("\nOut-of-factorial filter values (canonicalised):\n")
print(sort(table(.prev[!.unstated(filter) &
  !filter_canon %in% .grid_filters, filter_canon]), decreasing = TRUE))
cat("\nOut-of-factorial GIA values (canonicalised):\n")
print(sort(table(.prev[!.unstated(gia_model) &
  !gia_canon %in% .grid_gia, gia_canon]), decreasing = TRUE))
```

```{r literature-stats, dependson="load-tier-a", cache.extra=file.mtime(here::here("datasets","bibliometric","bibliometric_master_all.csv"))}

# LITERATURE SIGN-FLIP RISK ###################################################

# Unified 9-region bibliometric master.
bib_all <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "bibliometric",
                                          "bibliometric_master_all.csv"))
bib_all[, in_cohort := as.character(in_cohort) %in% c("True", "TRUE", "true")]

region_display <- c(
  igp = "IGP", central_valley = "Central Valley", high_plains = "High Plains",
  indus = "Indus", guarani = "Guarani", murray = "Murray",
  `murray-darling` = "Murray",
  arabian = "Arabian", mississippi = "Mississippi",
  north_china_plain = "North China Plain")
bib_all[, region_key := data.table::tstrsplit(region, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]]
bib_all[, region_label := region_display[region_key]]
bib_all[is.na(region_label), region_label := "other"]

# Corpus-size counters surfaced for inline R refs in the prose so the
# numbers track the master CSV without manual editing.
n_bib_all       <- nrow(bib_all)
n_bib_unique    <- data.table::uniqueN(bib_all$oa_id)
n_bib_in_cohort <- sum(bib_all$in_cohort)
n_bib_own_shm   <- sum(bib_all$paper_category == "own-SHM")
n_bib_own_shm_in_cohort <- sum(bib_all$paper_category == "own-SHM" &
                                  bib_all$in_cohort)

cat(sprintf("=== Paper category x region (%d paper-region records, %d unique) ===\n",
            n_bib_all, n_bib_unique))
print(data.table::dcast(bib_all[, .N, by = .(region_label, paper_category)],
                          paper_category ~ region_label,
                          value.var = "N", fill = 0))

# Recipe-value canonicalisation ----------------------------------------------
# The LLM records each axis verbatim from the paper.
canon_gia <- function(x) {
  x0 <- tolower(x)
  data.table::fcase(
    grepl("caron", x0),                  "Caron_2018",
    grepl("ice.?6g|ice6g", x0),          "Peltier_ICE6G_D",
    grepl("ice.?5g|ice5g|geruo|vm2", x0), "Geruo_ICE5G_VM2",
    x0 == "none",                        "none",
    default = x)
}
canon_filter <- function(x) {
  x0 <- tolower(x)
  data.table::fcase(
    grepl("swenson", x0) & grepl("500", x0), "Swenson_G500",
    grepl("swenson", x0) & grepl("300", x0), "Swenson_G300",
    default = x)
}
bib_all[, gia_model := canon_gia(gia_model)]
bib_all[, filter := canon_filter(filter)]

# The 1,920-recipe grid (index built from the per-recipe skill table).
recipe_grid <- per_recipe_skill[, .(recipe_idx = .I, centre, truncation,
                                      filter, gia_model, c20_treatment,
                                      c30_treatment, geocenter)]

# Candidate cohort sub-basins for each of the seven in-cohort regions.
candidate_aquifers <- list(
  "IGP" = c("Middle Gangetic Plain (Indo-Gangetic Plain)",
              "Upper Gangetic Plain (Indo-Gangetic Plain)",
              "Trans Gangetic Plain (Indo-Gangetic Plain)"),
  "High Plains" = c("Central High Plains (High Plains)",
                      "Northern High Plains (High Plains)",
                      "Southern High Plains (High Plains)"),
  "Indus" = c("Eastside Lower Indus Valley (Indus Basin)",
                "Eastside Middle Indus Plain (Indus Basin)"),
  "Guarani" = c(
    "Central Parana Basin and Torres Syncline (Guarani Aquifer System)",
    "Northern Guarani Aquifer (Guarani Aquifer System)",
    "Southwestern Chaco-Lower Parana Basin (Guarani Aquifer System)"),
  "Murray" = c("Southern Riverine Plains (Murray Basin)"),
  "Arabian" = c("Northcentral Mega Aquifer System (Mega Aquifer System)",
                  "Northern Mega Aquifer System (Mega Aquifer System)",
                  "Southcentral Mega Aquifer System (Mega Aquifer System)"),
  "Mississippi" = c("Central Mississippi Embayment (Mississippi Embayment)",
                      "Eastern Mississippi Embayment (Mississippi Embayment)"))

# Own-SHM in-cohort papers only, each scored on its exact study window
# (paper_study_windows.csv; per-window tables in
# datasets/output/tier_a_windows/).
source(here::here("functions", "window_match_fun.R"))
study_windows <- data.table::fread(here::here(
  "datasets", "bibliometric", "paper_study_windows.csv"))

bib_in <- bib_all[in_cohort == TRUE & paper_category == "own-SHM" &
                    region_label %in% names(candidate_aquifers)]
bib_in <- classify_paper_windows(bib_in, study_windows)
# Drop the two audit-flagged papers (paper_study_windows.csv `exclude`):
# Rodell & Famiglietti 2002 (pre-GRACE) and Fleming et al.
if ("exclude" %in% names(study_windows)) {
  .excl <- study_windows[as.character(exclude) %chin% c("TRUE", "True", "true"),
                          unique(paper_id)]
  if (length(.excl)) {
    cat(sprintf("Excluding %d audited paper(s) from the window analysis: %s\n",
                length(.excl), paste(.excl, collapse = ", ")))
    bib_in <- bib_in[!paper_id %in% .excl]
  }
}
cat(sprintf(paste0("\n=== own-SHM in-cohort papers: %d, across %d distinct ",
                   "study windows ===\n"),
            nrow(bib_in), data.table::uniqueN(bib_in$data_window)))
print(bib_in[, .(n_papers  = .N,
                 n_windows = data.table::uniqueN(data_window)),
             keyby = region_label])

# Match each paper to the recipe subset its stated method is compatible with.
matches <- literature_recipe_match_fun(bib_in, recipe_grid)
matches <- merge(matches,
                   bib_in[, .(paper_id, region_label, first_author, year,
                                citations, title, data_window)],
                   by = "paper_id")

# Build the per-window trend lookup.
trends_by_win <- load_per_recipe_trends_by_window(
  windows_dir = here::here("datasets", "output", "tier_a_windows"),
  recipe_grid = recipe_grid,
  windows     = unique(bib_in$data_window),
  basins      = unlist(candidate_aquifers, use.names = FALSE))

# Per-paper sign-flip risk: window-aware.
sign_flip_all <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(
  names(candidate_aquifers), function(reg) {
    pir <- matches[region_label == reg]
    if (nrow(pir) == 0L) return(NULL)
    sf <- compute_sign_flip_window_aware(pir, candidate_aquifers[[reg]],
                                            trends_by_win)
    sf[, region_label := reg]
    sf
  }), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

# Worst-case sign-flip risk across the paper's region sub-basins.
sign_flip_per_paper <- sign_flip_all[, .(
  worst_risk = max(sign_flip_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_matched  = max(n_matched, na.rm = TRUE),
  data_window = unique(data_window)),
  by = .(paper_id, region_label)]
sign_flip_per_paper <- merge(
  sign_flip_per_paper,
  bib_in[, .(paper_id, first_author, year, citations, title)],
  by = "paper_id")

cat("\n=== Per-paper worst-case sign-flip risk, by region ===\n")
print(sign_flip_per_paper[, .(
  n_papers = .N,
  median_risk = round(stats::median(worst_risk), 3),
  frac_zero = round(mean(worst_risk == 0), 2),
  frac_above_25pct = round(mean(worst_risk >= 0.25), 2)),
  keyby = region_label])

cat("\n=== Top-12 most-cited in-cohort papers, window-matched sign-flip risk ===\n")
data.table::setorder(sign_flip_per_paper, -citations)
print(sign_flip_per_paper[1:12, .(region_label, first_author, year,
                                     citations, data_window, n_matched,
                                     risk = round(worst_risk, 3))])

# Citation-weighted mean sign-flip risk per region.
cw_risk <- sign_flip_per_paper[citations > 0, .(
  cit_weighted_risk = round(sum(worst_risk * citations) / sum(citations), 3),
  n_papers = .N), keyby = region_label]
cat("\n=== Citation-weighted mean sign-flip risk per region ===\n")
print(cw_risk)

# Corpus scalars surfaced for inline references.
pct_own_proc  <- round(100 * bib_all[paper_category == "own-SHM",
                                       data.table::uniqueN(oa_id)] / n_bib_unique)
pct_inherited <- round(100 * bib_all[paper_category %chin%
                          c("mascon", "downstream-use"),
                          data.table::uniqueN(oa_id)] / n_bib_unique)
cwr <- function(r) sprintf("%.2f", cw_risk[.(r), cit_weighted_risk])
```

```{r literature-bias-test, dependson="literature-stats", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}

# SELECTION-SIGNATURE TEST ###################################################
# Per pair: delta = frac_dep(paper-compatible recipes) - frac_dep(full
# ensemble), window-matched.

# --- 1. Full-ensemble depleting fraction per (basin, window) ----------------
ens_dep <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(
  names(trends_by_win),
  function(win) {
    tw <- trends_by_win[[win]]
    out <- tw[, .(frac_dep_full = mean(trend < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                  med_full      = stats::median(trend, na.rm = TRUE),
                  absmed_full   = stats::median(abs(trend), na.rm = TRUE)),
              by = Study_area]
    out[, data_window := win]
    out
  }), use.names = TRUE)

# --- 2. Restrict to sign-paradox (paper, basin) pairs and join --------------
# Sign-paradox is evaluated on EACH PAPER'S OWN study window: a (paper, basin)
# pair qualifies iff the recipe ensemble spans both signs on that basin over
# the paper's window.
bias_pairs <- sign_flip_all[spans_zero == TRUE]
bias_pairs <- merge(bias_pairs,
                    ens_dep,
                    by.x = c("candidate_basin", "data_window"),
                    by.y = c("Study_area",      "data_window"),
                    all.x = TRUE)
bias_pairs <- bias_pairs[is.finite(frac_dep_full)]
bias_pairs[, delta_dep := frac_neg - frac_dep_full]

bias_pairs <- merge(bias_pairs,
                    bib_in[, .(paper_id, first_author, year,
                               citations)],
                    by = "paper_id")

cat(sprintf("=== Selection-signature test ===\n"))
cat(sprintf("Sign-paradox basins tested (paper-window):   %d\n",
            data.table::uniqueN(bias_pairs$candidate_basin)))
cat(sprintf("Eligible (paper x sign-paradox-aquifer) pairs: %d\n",
            nrow(bias_pairs)))
cat(sprintf("Distinct in-cohort own-SHM papers contributing: %d\n",
            data.table::uniqueN(bias_pairs$paper_id)))

# --- 3. Headline test: paired Wilcoxon on delta_dep -------------------------
test_pair <- stats::wilcox.test(bias_pairs$delta_dep,
                                  alternative = "greater")
test_two  <- stats::wilcox.test(bias_pairs$delta_dep,
                                  alternative = "two.sided")
median_delta <- stats::median(bias_pairs$delta_dep)
mean_delta   <- mean(bias_pairs$delta_dep)
n_pos        <- sum(bias_pairs$delta_dep > 0)
n_neg        <- sum(bias_pairs$delta_dep < 0)
n_zero       <- sum(bias_pairs$delta_dep == 0)
n_total      <- nrow(bias_pairs)

# Sign test (one-sided binomial) -- distribution-free fallback
bin_p <- stats::binom.test(n_pos, n_pos + n_neg,
                            p = 0.5, alternative = "greater")$p.value

cat(sprintf("\nDepletion-bias diagnostics (per paper-aquifer pair):\n"))
cat(sprintf("  pairs with delta > 0 (paper more depleting): %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            n_pos, 100 * n_pos / (n_pos + n_neg)))
cat(sprintf("  pairs with delta < 0 (paper more recharging): %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            n_neg, 100 * n_neg / (n_pos + n_neg)))
cat(sprintf("  pairs with delta == 0:                        %d\n", n_zero))
cat(sprintf("  median delta:                                  %+.3f\n",
            median_delta))
cat(sprintf("  mean   delta:                                  %+.3f\n",
            mean_delta))
cat(sprintf("\nStatistical tests against null (delta = 0):\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Wilcoxon, two-sided:                  p = %.4g\n",
            test_two$p.value))
cat(sprintf("  Wilcoxon, one-sided (delta > 0):      p = %.4g\n",
            test_pair$p.value))
cat(sprintf("  Sign test (binomial), one-sided:      p = %.4g\n", bin_p))

# --- 4. Per-paper aggregation (to defuse the multi-basin non-independence) --
per_paper <- bias_pairs[, .(
  mean_delta = mean(delta_dep, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_basins   = .N,
  citations  = unique(citations)[1L],
  region     = paste(sort(unique(region_label)), collapse = ";"),
  first_author = unique(first_author)[1L],
  year       = unique(year)[1L]),
  by = paper_id]

pp_test_two  <- stats::wilcox.test(per_paper$mean_delta,
                                     alternative = "two.sided")
pp_test_pair <- stats::wilcox.test(per_paper$mean_delta,
                                     alternative = "greater")
pp_n_pos <- sum(per_paper$mean_delta > 0)
pp_n_neg <- sum(per_paper$mean_delta < 0)
pp_bin_p <- stats::binom.test(pp_n_pos, pp_n_pos + pp_n_neg,
                                p = 0.5, alternative = "greater")$p.value

cat(sprintf("\n--- Per-paper aggregation (one row per paper) ---\n"))
cat(sprintf("  papers with mean_delta > 0: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            pp_n_pos, pp_n_pos + pp_n_neg,
            100 * pp_n_pos / (pp_n_pos + pp_n_neg)))
cat(sprintf("  median per-paper delta:     %+.3f\n",
            stats::median(per_paper$mean_delta, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Wilcoxon two-sided p:       %.4g\n", pp_test_two$p.value))
cat(sprintf("  Wilcoxon one-sided p:       %.4g\n", pp_test_pair$p.value))
cat(sprintf("  binomial sign-test p:       %.4g\n", pp_bin_p))

# --- 5. Per-region breakdown ------------------------------------------------
by_region <- bias_pairs[, .(
  n_pairs      = .N,
  median_delta = round(stats::median(delta_dep), 3),
  pct_paper_more_depleting = round(100 * mean(delta_dep > 0), 1),
  cit_weighted_delta = round(
    sum(delta_dep * citations) / sum(citations), 3)),
  keyby = region_label]
cat("\n--- Selection signature by region ---\n")
print(by_region)
```

```{r charitable-matching, dependson=c("literature-stats","literature-bias-test")}

# CHARITABLE RE-MATCHING -- UNSTATED CORRECTION = CORRECTION APPLIED ##########
# Per paper, an axis is "free" iff its matched recipe set spans more than
# one level of that axis (a stated value pins the axis, so a free axis is an
# unstated one).

.cm <- merge(matches, recipe_grid, by = "recipe_idx")
.free <- .cm[, .(
  c20_free = data.table::uniqueN(c20_treatment) > 1L,
  c30_free = data.table::uniqueN(c30_treatment) > 1L,
  geo_free = data.table::uniqueN(geocenter) > 1L,
  gia_free = any(gia_model == "none") & any(gia_model != "none")),
  by = paper_id]
.cm <- merge(.cm, .free, by = "paper_id")
matches_char <- .cm[(!c20_free | c20_treatment == "replaced") &
                      (!c30_free | c30_treatment == "replaced") &
                      (!geo_free | geocenter == "GravIS") &
                      (!gia_free | gia_model != "none")]
matches_char[, n_matched := .N, by = paper_id]

cat("=== Charitable re-matching: unstated correction axes -> corrected ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  papers re-matched                  : %d\n",
            data.table::uniqueN(matches_char$paper_id)))
cat(sprintf("  median compatible recipes per paper: %d -> %d\n",
            as.integer(stats::median(unique(matches,
              by = "paper_id")$n_matched)),
            as.integer(stats::median(unique(matches_char,
              by = "paper_id")$n_matched))))

sign_flip_char <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(
  names(candidate_aquifers), function(reg) {
    pir <- matches_char[region_label == reg]
    if (nrow(pir) == 0L) return(NULL)
    sf <- compute_sign_flip_window_aware(pir, candidate_aquifers[[reg]],
                                            trends_by_win)
    sf[, region_label := reg]
    sf
  }), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
sf_char_pp <- sign_flip_char[, .(worst_risk = max(sign_flip_risk,
                                                  na.rm = TRUE)),
                             by = .(paper_id, region_label)]

.risk_cmp <- merge(
  sign_flip_per_paper[, .(paper_id, region_label, risk_orig = worst_risk)],
  sf_char_pp[, .(paper_id, region_label, risk_char = worst_risk)],
  by = c("paper_id", "region_label"))
cat(sprintf("\n  median worst-case sign-flip risk   : %.3f -> %.3f (charitable)\n",
            stats::median(.risk_cmp$risk_orig),
            stats::median(.risk_cmp$risk_char)))
cat(sprintf("  papers with risk >= 0.25           : %d -> %d (of %d)\n",
            sum(.risk_cmp$risk_orig >= 0.25),
            sum(.risk_cmp$risk_char >= 0.25), nrow(.risk_cmp)))
cat("\n  median worst-case risk by region (original -> charitable):\n")
print(.risk_cmp[, .(orig = round(stats::median(risk_orig), 3),
                    char = round(stats::median(risk_char), 3),
                    n = .N), keyby = region_label])

# Selection-signature delta on the charitable sets ---------------------------

bias_char <- sign_flip_char[spans_zero == TRUE]
bias_char <- merge(bias_char, ens_dep,
                   by.x = c("candidate_basin", "data_window"),
                   by.y = c("Study_area",      "data_window"), all.x = TRUE)
bias_char <- bias_char[is.finite(frac_dep_full)]
bias_char[, delta_dep := frac_neg - frac_dep_full]
char_delta_med <- stats::median(bias_char$delta_dep)
char_delta_p   <- stats::wilcox.test(bias_char$delta_dep,
                                     alternative = "two.sided")$p.value
cat(sprintf("\n  selection-signature delta (median) : %+.3f -> %+.3f (charitable; two-sided Wilcoxon p = %.3f)\n",
            stats::median(bias_pairs$delta_dep), char_delta_med,
            char_delta_p))
cat(sprintf("  eligible paradox pairs             : %d -> %d\n",
            nrow(bias_pairs), nrow(bias_char)))
```

```{r claim-decirc-2x2, dependson="literature-stats", cache.extra=file.mtime(here::here("datasets","bibliometric","bibliometric_master_all.csv"))}

# DE-CIRCULARISED CLAIM CONCENTRATION (assumption-light 2x2) #################
# De-circularised test: uses only spans_zero on the paper's own window and the
# coded claim sign against a 50/50 null -- no ensemble depleting fraction enters.
claim_signs <- data.table::fread(
  here::here("datasets", "bibliometric", "claim_signs.csv"))
dec_dc  <- unique(sign_flip_all[, .(paper_id, candidate_basin, region_label,
                                    spans_zero)])
dec_dc  <- merge(dec_dc, claim_signs[, .(paper_id, claim_sign)],
                 by = "paper_id", all.x = TRUE)
dec_dc  <- dec_dc[!is.na(spans_zero)]
dec_dc[, status   := ifelse(spans_zero, "sign-paradox", "sign-consensus")]
dec_dc[, definite := claim_sign %chin% c("depleting", "recovering", "stable")]
dec_dc[, dep      := claim_sign == "depleting"]

# 2x2 among DEFINITE claims: basin status x (depletion vs other definite sign)
dec_tab <- dec_dc[definite == TRUE,
                  .(depletion = sum(dep), `recovering/stable` = sum(!dep)),
                  keyby = status]
dec_fisher_p <- stats::fisher.test(as.matrix(dec_tab[, -1]))$p.value

dec_pdx     <- dec_dc[status == "sign-paradox"]
dec_pairs   <- nrow(dec_pdx)
dec_def     <- sum(dec_pdx$definite)
dec_dep     <- sum(dec_pdx$dep)
dec_basins  <- data.table::uniqueN(dec_pdx$candidate_basin)
dec_pct_dep <- round(100 * dec_dep / dec_def)
dec_binom_p <- stats::binom.test(dec_dep, dec_def, 0.5)$p.value
dec_ppx     <- unique(dec_pdx[, .(paper_id, definite, dep)])
dec_pp_n    <- data.table::uniqueN(dec_pdx$paper_id)
dec_pp_def  <- sum(dec_ppx$definite)
dec_pp_dep  <- sum(dec_ppx$dep)
dec_pp_binom_p <- stats::binom.test(dec_pp_dep, dec_pp_def, 0.5)$p.value
dec_con     <- dec_dc[status == "sign-consensus" & definite == TRUE]
dec_con_def <- nrow(dec_con); dec_con_dep <- sum(dec_con$dep)

# LaTeX p-value formatter for inline prose
fmtp <- function(p) {
  if (p >= 1e-4) return(sprintf("%.3f", p))
  e <- floor(log10(p)); sprintf("%.1f \\times 10^{%d}", p / 10^e, e)
}
cat(sprintf("sign-paradox: %d/%d definite claims depletion (%.0f%%), binom p=%.2g; per-paper %d/%d p=%.2g\n",
            dec_dep, dec_def, 100 * dec_dep / dec_def, dec_binom_p,
            dec_pp_dep, dec_pp_def, dec_pp_binom_p))
cat(sprintf("sign-consensus: %d/%d depletion; Fisher (vs paradox) p=%.3f\n",
            dec_con_dep, dec_con_def, dec_fisher_p))
# Per-paper collapse of the consensus side, mirroring dec_ppx above.
dec_cpx <- unique(dec_dc[status == "sign-consensus",
                         .(paper_id, definite, dep)])
cat(sprintf("sign-consensus per-paper: %d/%d definite claims depletion\n",
            sum(dec_cpx$dep[dec_cpx$definite]), sum(dec_cpx$definite)))

knitr::kable(dec_tab, booktabs = TRUE,
  caption = paste0("Definite published trend-sign claims by basin sign-status ",
    "(paper-basin pairs; Fisher $p=", sprintf("%.2f", dec_fisher_p), "$)."),
  col.names = c("basin sign-status", "depletion claims",
                "recovering/stable claims"))
```

```{r claim-concentration-test, dependson="literature-bias-test"}

# CLAIM-CONCENTRATION TEST ###################################################
# Per pair: claim_dep (LLM-extracted claim sign, classify_claim_signs.py +
# manual overrides) minus f_ens (ensemble depleting share).

# --- 1. Load the per-paper claim-sign labels --------------------------------
claim_signs <- data.table::fread(
  here::here("datasets", "bibliometric", "claim_signs.csv"))

cat(sprintf("=== Claim-sign labels ===\n"))
print(claim_signs[, .N, keyby = claim_sign])

# --- 2. Join to the B-regime pair dataset (own-SHM) -------------------------
claim_pairs <- merge(
  bias_pairs[, .(paper_id, candidate_basin, region_label, data_window,
                  frac_dep_full, frac_neg, citations,
                  first_author, year)],
  claim_signs[, .(paper_id, claim_sign)],
  by = "paper_id", all.x = TRUE)

# Restrict to pairs with a *binary* sign claim (drop "mixed", "no-sign",
# and empty).
claim_pairs_clear <- claim_pairs[
  claim_sign %in% c("depleting", "recovering", "stable")]
claim_pairs_clear[, claim_dep := as.integer(claim_sign == "depleting")]
claim_pairs_clear[, delta_claim := claim_dep - frac_dep_full]

cat(sprintf("\nB-regime paper-aquifer pairs with a binary sign claim: %d\n",
            nrow(claim_pairs_clear)))
cat(sprintf("Distinct contributing papers: %d\n",
            data.table::uniqueN(claim_pairs_clear$paper_id)))
cat(sprintf("Distinct B-regime aquifers covered: %d\n",
            data.table::uniqueN(claim_pairs_clear$candidate_basin)))

# --- 3. Headline test: Wilcoxon one-sided on delta_claim --------------------
cc_test_pair <- stats::wilcox.test(claim_pairs_clear$delta_claim,
                                     alternative = "greater")
cc_test_two  <- stats::wilcox.test(claim_pairs_clear$delta_claim,
                                     alternative = "two.sided")
cc_mean      <- mean(claim_pairs_clear$delta_claim)
cc_median    <- stats::median(claim_pairs_clear$delta_claim)
cc_n_pos     <- sum(claim_pairs_clear$delta_claim > 0)
cc_n_neg     <- sum(claim_pairs_clear$delta_claim < 0)
cc_n_zero    <- sum(claim_pairs_clear$delta_claim == 0)
cc_bin_p     <- stats::binom.test(cc_n_pos, cc_n_pos + cc_n_neg,
                                    p = 0.5, alternative = "greater")$p.value

cat(sprintf("\n--- Per-pair test ---\n"))
cat(sprintf("  delta_claim > 0 (claim more depleting than ensemble): %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            cc_n_pos, 100 * cc_n_pos / (cc_n_pos + cc_n_neg)))
cat(sprintf("  delta_claim < 0 (claim more recharging): %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            cc_n_neg, 100 * cc_n_neg / (cc_n_pos + cc_n_neg)))
cat(sprintf("  delta_claim = 0: %d\n", cc_n_zero))
cat(sprintf("  mean delta_claim:   %+.3f\n", cc_mean))
cat(sprintf("  median delta_claim: %+.3f\n", cc_median))
cat(sprintf("  Wilcoxon one-sided p (claim > ensemble): %.4g\n",
            cc_test_pair$p.value))
cat(sprintf("  Wilcoxon two-sided p:                    %.4g\n",
            cc_test_two$p.value))
cat(sprintf("  Binomial sign-test p (one-sided):        %.4g\n", cc_bin_p))

# --- 4. Per-paper aggregation (defuses multi-aquifer non-independence) ------
cc_pp <- claim_pairs_clear[, .(
  delta_mean = mean(delta_claim, na.rm = TRUE),
  claim_dep  = unique(claim_dep)[1L],
  n_aquifers = .N,
  citations  = unique(citations)[1L],
  first_author = unique(first_author)[1L],
  year       = unique(year)[1L],
  region     = paste(sort(unique(region_label)), collapse = ";")),
  by = paper_id]
cc_pp_test <- stats::wilcox.test(cc_pp$delta_mean, alternative = "greater")
cc_pp_n_pos <- sum(cc_pp$delta_mean > 0)
cc_pp_n_neg <- sum(cc_pp$delta_mean < 0)
cat(sprintf("\n--- Per-paper aggregation ---\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Papers with mean delta_claim > 0: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            cc_pp_n_pos, cc_pp_n_pos + cc_pp_n_neg,
            100 * cc_pp_n_pos / (cc_pp_n_pos + cc_pp_n_neg)))
cat(sprintf("  Median per-paper delta_claim:    %+.3f\n",
            stats::median(cc_pp$delta_mean, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Wilcoxon one-sided p (per-paper): %.4g\n",
            cc_pp_test$p.value))

# --- 5. Per-region summary --------------------------------------------------
cc_region <- claim_pairs_clear[, .(
  n_pairs   = .N,
  n_papers  = data.table::uniqueN(paper_id),
  n_dep     = sum(claim_dep == 1),
  n_nondep  = sum(claim_dep == 0),
  f_lit     = mean(claim_dep),
  f_ens     = mean(frac_dep_full),
  delta     = mean(delta_claim),
  cit_weighted_delta = sum(delta_claim * citations) / sum(citations)),
  keyby = region_label]
cat("\n--- Per-region claim-concentration summary ---\n")
print(cc_region)

# Region-level test: one delta per region, defusing within-region clustering.
cc_rg_p <- suppressWarnings(stats::wilcox.test(cc_region$delta,
                                               alternative = "greater")$p.value)
cat(sprintf("  regions with delta > 0: %d / %d | one-sided signed-rank p = %.3f\n",
    sum(cc_region$delta > 0), nrow(cc_region), cc_rg_p))
stopifnot(sum(cc_region$delta > 0) == 5L, nrow(cc_region) == 6L,
          round(cc_rg_p, 3) == 0.047)
```

```{r claims-gws, dependson=c("literature-stats","literature-bias-test","claim-decirc-2x2","claim-concentration-test"), cache.extra=file.mtime(here::here("datasets","output","tier_a","gws_aux_window_trends_gldas.csv"))}

# CLAIM SCORING IN GROUNDWATER SPACE #########################################
# trends_by_win holds the per-window per-recipe TWS trends used by the claim
# analyses.

aux_win <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output", "tier_a",
                                        "gws_aux_window_trends_gldas.csv"))
.rg_ct <- recipe_grid[, .(recipe_idx, centre, truncation)]
trends_by_win_gws <- stats::setNames(lapply(names(trends_by_win),
  function(win) {
    tw <- merge(trends_by_win[[win]], .rg_ct, by = "recipe_idx")
    tw <- merge(tw, aux_win[data_window == win,
                            .(Study_area, centre, truncation,
                              aux_trend_cmyr)],
                by = c("Study_area", "centre", "truncation"))
    tw[, .(recipe_idx, Study_area, trend = trend - aux_trend_cmyr)]
  }), names(trends_by_win))
stopifnot(all(sapply(names(trends_by_win), function(w)
  nrow(trends_by_win_gws[[w]]) == nrow(trends_by_win[[w]]))))

sign_flip_gws <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(
  names(candidate_aquifers), function(reg) {
    pir <- matches[region_label == reg]
    if (nrow(pir) == 0L) return(NULL)
    sf <- compute_sign_flip_window_aware(pir, candidate_aquifers[[reg]],
                                            trends_by_win_gws)
    sf[, region_label := reg]
    sf
  }), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

ens_dep_gws <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(
  names(trends_by_win_gws), function(win) {
    out <- trends_by_win_gws[[win]][, .(
      frac_dep_full = mean(trend < 0, na.rm = TRUE)), by = Study_area]
    out[, data_window := win]
    out
  }), use.names = TRUE)

# De-circularised 2x2 on GWS ensembles ---------------------------------------
gdec <- unique(sign_flip_gws[, .(paper_id, candidate_basin, spans_zero)])
gdec <- merge(gdec, claim_signs[, .(paper_id, claim_sign)],
              by = "paper_id", all.x = TRUE)
gdec <- gdec[!is.na(spans_zero)]
gdec[, definite := claim_sign %chin% c("depleting", "recovering", "stable")]
gdec[, dep := claim_sign == "depleting"]
gdec_pdx <- gdec[spans_zero == TRUE & definite == TRUE]
gdec_dep <- sum(gdec_pdx$dep); gdec_def <- nrow(gdec_pdx)
gdec_binom_p <- stats::binom.test(gdec_dep, gdec_def, 0.5)$p.value

# delta_claim on GWS ensembles ------------------------------------------------
gbias <- sign_flip_gws[spans_zero == TRUE]
gbias <- merge(gbias, ens_dep_gws,
               by.x = c("candidate_basin", "data_window"),
               by.y = c("Study_area",      "data_window"), all.x = TRUE)
gbias <- gbias[is.finite(frac_dep_full)]
gclaims <- merge(gbias[, .(paper_id, candidate_basin, frac_dep_full)],
                 claim_signs[, .(paper_id, claim_sign)],
                 by = "paper_id", all.x = TRUE)
gclaims <- gclaims[claim_sign %chin% c("depleting", "recovering", "stable")]
gclaims[, claim_dep := as.integer(claim_sign == "depleting")]
gclaims[, delta_claim := claim_dep - frac_dep_full]
gcc_mean <- mean(gclaims$delta_claim)
gcc_p <- stats::wilcox.test(gclaims$delta_claim,
                            alternative = "greater")$p.value

cat("=== Claim scoring in groundwater space (GLDAS auxiliary) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  2x2 paradox cell, depletion share : GWS %d/%d (%.0f%%), binom p=%.2g   [TWS %d/%d (%.0f%%), p=%.2g]\n",
            gdec_dep, gdec_def, 100 * gdec_dep / gdec_def, gdec_binom_p,
            dec_dep, dec_def, 100 * dec_dep / dec_def, dec_binom_p))
cat(sprintf("  delta_claim mean                  : GWS %+.2f (one-sided p=%.2g)   [TWS %+.2f (p=%.2g)]\n",
            gcc_mean, gcc_p, cc_mean, cc_test_pair$p.value))
cat(sprintf("  eligible (paper, basin) pairs     : GWS %d   [TWS %d]\n",
            nrow(gclaims), nrow(claim_pairs_clear)))
```

```{r corpus-completeness-sensitivity, dependson=c("claim-decirc-2x2","claim-concentration-test","policy-uptake-stats"), cache.extra=file.mtime(here::here("datasets","bibliometric","bibliometric_master_all.csv"))}

# CORPUS-COMPLETENESS SENSITIVITY ############################################
# Re-run the claim headline and the policy footprint BEFORE vs AFTER the
# nine-region OpenAlex top-up.
.nd <- function(d) tolower(gsub("^https?://(dx\\.)?doi\\.org/", "", trimws(as.character(d))))
.prov <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "bibliometric", "corpus_provenance.csv"))
.bpk  <- bib_all[, .(paper_id, oa_id, doi)]
.bpk[, pk := data.table::fifelse(.nd(doi) != "", .nd(doi), paste0("oa::", oa_id))]
.bpk  <- merge(.bpk, .prov[, .(pk, source)], by = "pk", all.x = TRUE)
.orig_pids <- unique(.bpk[source == "original", paper_id])
.orig_pk   <- .prov[source == "original", pk]

# claim substrate (in-memory); paradox status is per (paper,
# basin) on the paper's OWN study window (spans_zero from sign_flip_all),
# matching the de-circularised test.
.dc <- merge(unique(sign_flip_all[, .(paper_id, candidate_basin, spans_zero)]),
             claim_signs[, .(paper_id, claim_sign)], by = "paper_id", all.x = TRUE)
.dc[, paradox  := spans_zero]
.dc[, definite := claim_sign %chin% c("depleting", "recovering", "stable")]
.dc[, dep      := claim_sign == "depleting"]
.cl <- merge(bias_pairs[, .(paper_id, candidate_basin, frac_dep_full)],
             claim_signs[, .(paper_id, claim_sign)], by = "paper_id", all.x = TRUE)
.cl <- .cl[claim_sign %chin% c("depleting", "recovering", "stable")]
.cl[, delta := as.integer(claim_sign == "depleting") - frac_dep_full]

# policy substrate (full-corpus Altmetric survey)
.pcite <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "bibliometric", "policy_citations_fullcorpus.csv"))
.pdoc  <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "bibliometric", "policy_documents_fullcorpus.csv"))
.pcite[, pk := .nd(doi)]   # Altmetric policy data is DOI-keyed (no oa_id column)
.pdoc[,  pk := .nd(doi)]

.sens <- function(pids, pks, lab) {
  pdx <- .dc[paper_id %in% pids & paradox == TRUE & definite == TRUE]
  cpp <- .cl[paper_id %in% pids, .(dm = mean(delta)), by = paper_id]
  data.table::data.table(
    corpus = lab,
    n_papers = length(pks),
    dep_definite = sprintf("%d/%d (%.0f%%)", sum(pdx$dep), nrow(pdx), 100 * mean(pdx$dep)),
    binom_p = sprintf("%.0e", stats::binom.test(sum(pdx$dep), nrow(pdx), 0.5)$p.value),
    mean_delta = sprintf("%+.2f", mean(.cl[paper_id %in% pids, delta])),
    delta_p = sprintf("%.0e", suppressWarnings(stats::wilcox.test(cpp$dm, alternative = "greater")$p.value)),
    policy_papers = sum(.pcite[pk %in% pks, n_policy_documents] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    policy_links = nrow(.pdoc[pk %in% pks]))
}
sens_tab <- rbind(.sens(.orig_pids, .orig_pk, "Before top-up"),
                  .sens(unique(.dc$paper_id), .prov$pk, "After top-up (full)"))
sens_n_added <- nrow(.prov) - length(.orig_pk)
sens_miss_before <- nrow(.bpk[paper_id %in% .orig_pids & paper_id %in% bib_all[region == "mississippi", paper_id]])
sens_miss_after  <- nrow(bib_all[region == "mississippi"])
print(sens_tab)

knitr::kable(sens_tab, booktabs = TRUE,
  caption = paste0("Claim-concentration and policy results before and after ",
    "the nine-region OpenAlex corpus top-up (", sens_n_added, " papers added)."),
  col.names = c("corpus", "papers", "dep/definite (paradox)", "binom $p$",
                "mean $\\Delta_{\\mathrm{claim}}$", "$\\Delta$ $p$",
                "policy papers", "policy links"))
```

```{r policy-triangulation-direct, dependson="policy-context-stats", cache.extra=file.mtime(here::here("datasets","bibliometric","policy_triangulation_direct.csv"))}

# DIRECT POLICY TRIANGULATION (beyond Altmetric) ############################
# Verbatim, page-referenced GRACE-derived claims in the four canonical IGO
# flagship report families.

tri <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "bibliometric",
                                    "policy_triangulation_direct.csv"))
n_tri        <- nrow(tri)
n_fam_tri    <- length(unique(tri$report_short))
n_corpus_tri <- sum(!grepl("n\\.c\\.|non-corpus", tri$paper_short))
n_unc_tri    <- sum(tri$context_class == "uncertainty")
n_new_tri    <- sum(tri$altmetric_link == "no")

cat("=== Direct policy triangulation (beyond Altmetric) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Flagship report families directly retrieved: %d\n", n_fam_tri))
cat(sprintf("Verbatim GRACE-derived passages:             %d\n", n_tri))
cat(sprintf("  pinned to a corpus paper:                  %d\n", n_corpus_tri))
cat(sprintf("  reproducing a GRACE/methods uncertainty:   %d\n", n_unc_tri))
cat(sprintf("  link Altmetric missed entirely:            %d\n", n_new_tri))

knitr::kable(
  tri[, .(report_short, year, paper_short, fig_short, context_class, altmetric_link)],
  booktabs = TRUE,
  caption = paste0("GRACE-derived groundwater claims retrieved directly from ",
    "flagship intergovernmental reports (full quotes and pages in ",
    "\\texttt{policy\\_triangulation\\_direct.csv})."),
  col.names = c("flagship report", "yr", "corpus paper", "GRACE figure",
                "context", "Altmetric"))

  order(-m), region_label]
sf_pp[, region_label := factor(region_label, levels = risk_order)]
sf_pp[, log_cit := log10(pmax(citations, 1))]

keep_lo  <- lab_pool[worst_risk < 0.05,
                     paper_id[which.max(citations)], by = region_label]$V1
lit_labelled <- lab_pool[worst_risk >= 0.05 | paper_id %in% keep_lo]
# Short citation label for panel (b): surname (last whitespace-delimited token
# of first_author) + year.
lit_labelled[, surname := stringi::stri_trans_general(

lit_labelled[, lab := sprintf("%s et al. %d", surname, year)]

p_b_lit <- ggplot(sf_pp, aes(x = jitter_x, y = worst_risk, size = log_cit)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.10, 0.25, 0.40), linetype = "dashed",

# Panel (c): Rodell 2009 recipe cloud on the Middle Gangetic Plain -----------

# Consequences for the literature and for policy

```{r worked-example-murray, dependson="prelim", cache.extra=c(file.mtime(here::here("datasets","output",.tier_a_subdir,"jasechko_per_recipe_trends.csv.gz")), file.mtime(here::here("datasets","bibliometric","claim_signs.csv")), file.mtime(here::here("datasets","bibliometric","policy_triangulation_direct.csv")))}

# WORKED EXAMPLE: MURRAY-DARLING BASIN ######################################
# An existence proof: a basin the
# 1,920-recipe ensemble CANNOT sign (regime B; recipe-median GAINING over
# the full record).

we_tr <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output", .tier_a_subdir,
                                      "jasechko_per_recipe_trends.csv.gz"))
we_t  <- we_tr[Study_area == "Southern Riverine Plains (Murray Basin)", trend_cm_yr]
we_n  <- length(we_t)
we_med <- stats::median(we_t)
we_q1 <- stats::quantile(we_t, .25); we_q3 <- stats::quantile(we_t, .75)
we_R  <- unname((we_q3 - we_q1) / abs(we_med))
we_gain <- mean(we_t > 0) * 100; we_dep <- mean(we_t < 0) * 100

we_cl  <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "bibliometric", "claim_signs.csv"))
we_leb <- we_cl[grepl("Leblanc", first_author) & year == 2009][1]

# Leblanc's claim is defensible ON ITS OWN drought window: load the recipe
# ensemble sliced to that window and report its Murray verdict.
we_sw     <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "bibliometric",
                                          "paper_study_windows.csv"))
we_lw     <- we_sw[grepl("Leblanc", first_author) & year == 2009][1]
we_lebkey <- sprintf("%s_%s", we_lw$win_start, we_lw$win_end)
we_lebtr  <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output",
  "tier_a_windows", sprintf("jasechko_per_recipe_trends__%s.csv", we_lebkey)))
we_lt     <- we_lebtr[Study_area == "Southern Riverine Plains (Murray Basin)",
                      trend_cm_yr]
we_leb_med <- stats::median(we_lt)
we_leb_dep <- mean(we_lt < 0) * 100

cat("=== Worked example: Murray-Darling Basin (Southern Riverine Plains) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("FULL record (%d recipes): recipe-median %+.2f cm/yr (%s); "
            , we_n, we_med, ifelse(we_med > 0, "GAINING", "depleting")))
cat(sprintf("IQR [%+.2f, %+.2f] | R = %.1f | %.0f%% gaining, %.0f%% depleting\n",
            we_q1, we_q3, we_R, we_gain, we_dep))
cat(sprintf("Leblanc WINDOW (%s, %d recipes): recipe-median %+.2f cm/yr; %.0f%% depleting (consensus)\n",
            gsub("_", " to ", we_lebkey), length(we_lt), we_leb_med, we_leb_dep))
cat(sprintf("Published claim (Leblanc 2009): %s -> %s\n",
            we_leb$depletion_claim, we_leb$claim_sign))

# FIG: CONSEQUENCES FOR THE LITERATURE AND POLICY (composite) #################

# --- Panel (a): per-paper worst-case sign-flip risk by region ----------------
# sign_flip_per_paper from literature-stats: one row per own-SHM in-cohort

sfp <- data.table::copy(sign_flip_per_paper)
reg_ord <- sfp[, stats::median(worst_risk), by = region_label][order(-V1), region_label]
sfp[, region_lab := factor(region_label, levels = reg_ord)]
sfp_med <- sfp[, .(med = stats::median(worst_risk)), by = region_lab]
set.seed(3L)
p_risk <- ggplot(sfp, aes(region_lab, worst_risk)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.18, height = 0, size = 0.9, alpha = 0.55,
              colour = "#b5543a", shape = 16) +
  geom_point(data = sfp_med, aes(region_lab, med), shape = 124,
             size = 4, colour = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.3,
             colour = "grey55") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0, 0.52)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "sign-flip risk") +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())

# --- Panel (b): claims vs the admissible recipe space (dumbbell) -------------
ccr <- data.table::copy(cc_region)
ccr[, region_lab := factor(region_label,
                           levels = ccr[order(-delta), region_label])]
p_dumb <- ggplot(ccr) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = region_lab, xend = region_lab,
                   y = f_ens, yend = f_lit),
               colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(region_lab, f_ens), shape = 21, size = 2,
             colour = "#2c7bb6", fill = "white", stroke = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(region_lab, f_lit), shape = 16, size = 2,
             colour = "#8b3a3a") +
  geom_text(aes(region_lab, f_lit + 0.085,
                label = sprintf("%+.2f", delta)),
            size = 1.8, colour = "#8b3a3a") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0, 1.14),
                     breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "depleting fraction") +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())

# --- Panel (c): policy links per region, stacked by audited context ----------
pol_reg <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "bibliometric",
                                        "policy_fullcorpus_by_region.csv"))
pol_cls <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "bibliometric",
                                        "policy_context_final_classification.csv"))
cls_reg <- pol_cls[, .N, by = .(region, final_class)]
rdisp_c <- c(igp = "IGP", central_valley = "Central Valley",
             arabian = "Arabian", high_plains = "High Plains",
             mississippi = "Mississippi", north_china_plain = "N China Plain",
             murray = "Murray", indus = "Indus", guarani = "Guarani")
stack_c <- merge(pol_reg[, .(region, total = n_policy_citations)],
                 data.table::dcast(cls_reg, region ~ final_class,
                                   value.var = "N", fill = 0),
                 by = "region", all.x = TRUE)
for (cc in c("evidentiary", "recommendation-linked"))
  if (!cc %in% names(stack_c)) stack_c[, (cc) := 0L]
stack_c[is.na(evidentiary), evidentiary := 0L]
stack_c[is.na(`recommendation-linked`), `recommendation-linked` := 0L]
stack_c[, background := total - evidentiary - `recommendation-linked`]
stack_long <- data.table::melt(
  stack_c[, .(region, background, evidentiary,
              `recommendation-linked`)],
  id.vars = "region", variable.name = "cls", value.name = "n")
stack_long[, cls := factor(cls, levels = c("background", "evidentiary",
                                           "recommendation-linked"))]
stack_long[, region_lab := factor(rdisp_c[region],
            levels = rdisp_c[pol_reg[order(n_policy_citations), region]])]
p_pol <- ggplot(stack_long, aes(n, region_lab, fill = cls)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(background = "grey85",
                               evidentiary = "#4a6680",
                               `recommendation-linked` = "#b5543a"),
                    labels = c("background / unaudited", "evidentiary",
                               "recommendation-linked"),
                    name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))) +
  labs(x = "policy-citation links", y = NULL) +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.position = c(0.98, 0.04),
        legend.justification = c(1, 0),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.28, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 5.4),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

# --- Panel (d): the Murray exemplar -- study window vs full record -----------
.swd <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "bibliometric",
                                     "paper_study_windows.csv"))
.lwd <- .swd[grepl("Leblanc", first_author) & year == 2009][1]
.lkey <- sprintf("%s_%s", .lwd$win_start, .lwd$win_end)
mur_win <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output", "tier_a_windows",
            sprintf("jasechko_per_recipe_trends__%s.csv", .lkey)))[
  Study_area == "Southern Riverine Plains (Murray Basin)" &
    is.finite(trend_cm_yr)]
mur_full <- data.table::fread(here::here("datasets", "output", .tier_a_subdir,
            "jasechko_per_recipe_trends.csv.gz"))[
  Study_area == "Southern Riverine Plains (Murray Basin)" &
    is.finite(trend_cm_yr)]
lab_win  <- sprintf("study window\n(%s to %s)",
                    substr(.lwd$win_start, 1, 4), substr(.lwd$win_end, 1, 4))
lab_full <- "full record\n(2002 to 2025)"
mur <- rbind(data.table::data.table(win = lab_win,  trend = mur_win$trend_cm_yr),

mur[, win := factor(win, levels = c(lab_full, lab_win))]  # window on top
mur[, sgn := factor(data.table::fifelse(trend < 0, "depleting", "gaining"),

mur_med <- mur[, .(med = stats::median(trend)), by = win]

p_mur <- ggplot(mur, aes(trend, win, colour = sgn)) +
