# Decision matrix

```{r aquifer-regimes, dependson=c("load-tier-a","sign-paradox-stats","boundary-ci","literature-stats")}

# AQUIFER DECISION MATRIX -- FOUR REGIMES ######################################
# Per-aquifer policy verdict.

boundary  <- bnd_t1_loess$est
R_thresh  <- 1.0

# Per-aquifer assembly
aq_reg <- merge(
  gradient_data[, .(Study_area, abs_GRACE_trend, dominance_R,
                    climate_zone, area_km2)],
  sign_paradox[, .(Study_area, spans_zero, sign_agree)],
  by = "Study_area")

# Literature coverage: papers per region from the 9-region bibliometric
# corpus, mapped to cohort aquifers via candidate_aquifers.
aq_to_region <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(
  names(candidate_aquifers),
  function(r) data.table::data.table(Study_area = candidate_aquifers[[r]],
                                      region = r)))
papers_per_region <- bib_in[, .N, by = region_label]
data.table::setnames(papers_per_region, "region_label", "region")
aq_to_region <- merge(aq_to_region, papers_per_region,
                      by = "region", all.x = TRUE)
aq_to_region[is.na(N), N := 0L]
aq_reg <- merge(aq_reg,
                aq_to_region[, .(Study_area, n_lit_papers = N)],
                by = "Study_area", all.x = TRUE)
aq_reg[is.na(n_lit_papers), n_lit_papers := 0L]

# Dedicated-paper evidence (datasets/bibliometric/option_b/) moves eight
# umbrellas from regime D to regime B.
.opt_b_path <- here::here("datasets", "bibliometric", "option_b",
                           "d_regime_reclassification.csv")
.opt_b_drg  <- here::here("datasets", "bibliometric", "option_b",
                           "d_regime_aquifers.csv")
if (file.exists(.opt_b_path) && file.exists(.opt_b_drg)) {
  opt_b <- data.table::fread(.opt_b_path)
  drg   <- data.table::fread(.opt_b_drg)
  # Umbrellas where Option B found >= 1 dedicated paper
  b_was_d_umbrellas <- opt_b[grepl("^B \\(was D\\)", new_regime),
                              umbrella_short]
  b_was_d_aqs <- drg[umbrella_short %in% b_was_d_umbrellas, Study_area]
  cat(sprintf("Option B reclassification: %d Tier-1 sub-basins move D -> B\n",
              length(b_was_d_aqs)))
  # For each such aquifer, bump n_lit_papers to at least 1 (or carry the
  # Option B candidate count, whichever is larger).
  ob_count_by_aq <- merge(
    drg[, .(Study_area, umbrella_short)],
    opt_b[, .(umbrella_short, n_ob_dedicated = n_dedicated)],
    by = "umbrella_short", all.x = TRUE)
  ob_count_by_aq[is.na(n_ob_dedicated), n_ob_dedicated := 0L]
  aq_reg <- merge(aq_reg,
                  ob_count_by_aq[, .(Study_area, n_ob_dedicated)],
                  by = "Study_area", all.x = TRUE)
  aq_reg[is.na(n_ob_dedicated), n_ob_dedicated := 0L]
  aq_reg[, n_lit_papers := pmax(n_lit_papers, n_ob_dedicated)]
} else {
  cat("Option B verdict not found -- skipping overlay; regimes use the\n",
      "9-region literature coverage only.\n", sep = "")
  aq_reg[, n_ob_dedicated := 0L]
}

# Regime assignment.
aq_reg[, regime := data.table::fcase(
  !spans_zero & dominance_R <  R_thresh, "A: policy-grade",
  !spans_zero & dominance_R >= R_thresh, "C: magnitude unresolved",
  spans_zero  & n_lit_papers == 0L,      "D: latent hazard",
  spans_zero  & n_lit_papers >  0L,      "B: cannot adjudicate sign")]

# Surface counts as variables (referenced inline below).
n_A <- sum(aq_reg$regime == "A: policy-grade")
n_B <- sum(aq_reg$regime == "B: cannot adjudicate sign")
n_C <- sum(aq_reg$regime == "C: magnitude unresolved")
n_D <- sum(aq_reg$regime == "D: latent hazard")
N_tier1 <- nrow(aq_reg)
stopifnot(n_A + n_B + n_C + n_D == N_tier1)

# Summary table
regime_summary <- aq_reg[, .(
  n_aquifers     = .N,
  area_Mkm2      = round(sum(area_km2, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e6, 2),
  area_pct       = sprintf("%.0f%%",
                            100 * sum(area_km2, na.rm = TRUE)
                            / sum(aq_reg$area_km2, na.rm = TRUE)),
  median_R       = round(stats::median(dominance_R, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
  median_trend   = round(stats::median(abs_GRACE_trend, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
  median_lit_papers = as.numeric(stats::median(n_lit_papers))),
  keyby = regime]

cat("=== Tier 1 aquifer regimes (W-FULL 22-year record) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Detectability boundary used: %.2f cm/yr  (Tier-1 loess R = 1 crossing)\n",
            boundary))
cat(sprintf("R threshold for 'magnitude unresolved': %.2f\n\n", R_thresh))
print(regime_summary)
cat(sprintf("\nN_tier1 = %d aquifers; A+B+C+D = %d\n",
            N_tier1, n_A + n_B + n_C + n_D))

# Latent-hazard list (regime D), sorted by sign-agreement
latent <- aq_reg[regime == "D: latent hazard",
                 .(Study_area, climate_zone,
                   area_kkm2  = round(area_km2 / 1000, 1),
                   sign_agree = round(sign_agree, 3),
                   abs_trend  = round(abs_GRACE_trend, 3),
                   R          = round(dominance_R, 2))]
data.table::setorder(latent, sign_agree)

cat(sprintf("\n=== Latent hazards (regime D): %d aquifers, %.2f Mkm^2 ===\n",
            nrow(latent), sum(latent$area_kkm2) / 1000))
cat("(sign-paradox AND no published GRACE-groundwater paper in the bibliometric corpus)\n\n")
print(latent[1:min(20L, nrow(latent))])

# B regime (sign-paradox with literature) -- the exposed published claims
exposed <- aq_reg[regime == "B: cannot adjudicate sign",
                  .(Study_area, climate_zone,
                    n_lit_papers,
                    sign_agree = round(sign_agree, 3),
                    abs_trend  = round(abs_GRACE_trend, 3))]
data.table::setorder(exposed, sign_agree)
cat(sprintf("\n=== Sign-paradox aquifers WITH literature exposure (regime B): %d ===\n",
            nrow(exposed)))
print(exposed)

# Save the per-aquifer regime classification for downstream use
data.table::fwrite(
  aq_reg[, .(Study_area, climate_zone, area_km2,
             abs_GRACE_trend, dominance_R, sign_agree, spans_zero,
             n_lit_papers, regime)],
  file.path(tier_a_dir, "aquifer_regimes.csv"))
cat(sprintf("\nWrote %d-row regime table to %s/aquifer_regimes.csv\n",
            nrow(aq_reg), .tier_a_subdir))
```

```{r fig-decision-matrix, dependson="aquifer-regimes", fig.width=5.8, fig.height=4.2}

# FIG 7: DECISION MATRIX -- FOUR-REGIME SCATTER ################################

regime_levels <- c("A: policy-grade",
                   "C: magnitude unresolved",
                   "B: cannot adjudicate sign",
                   "D: latent hazard")
regime_cols <- c("A: policy-grade"          = "#1a9850",
                 "C: magnitude unresolved"  = "#fdae61",
                 "B: cannot adjudicate sign"= "#d73027",
                 "D: latent hazard"         = "#7e2a9c")
aq_reg[, regime_factor := factor(regime, levels = regime_levels)]

label_set <- aq_reg[
  (regime == "D: latent hazard" & sign_agree < 0.60) |
  (regime == "B: cannot adjudicate sign" & sign_agree < 0.75) |
  Study_area %in% c("Middle Gangetic Plain (Indo-Gangetic Plain)",
                    "Northern High Plains (High Plains)")]
.trim_terminal <- function(x)
  sub("\\s+(Basin|Plain|Valley|Plateau|Upland|Aquifer System|Aquifer|System|Embayment|Depocenter|Syncline)$",
      "", x)
label_set[, short_lab := vapply(Study_area, function(s) {
  m <- regmatches(s, regexec("^(.*?)\\s*\\((.*)\\)\\s*$", s))[[1L]]
  raw <- if (length(m) == 3L) m[2L] else s
  .trim_terminal(raw)
}, character(1L))]

y_lo <- 10^floor(log10(min(aq_reg$dominance_R[aq_reg$dominance_R > 0],
                            na.rm = TRUE)))
y_hi <- 10^ceiling(log10(max(aq_reg$dominance_R, na.rm = TRUE)))

p_dm <- ggplot(aq_reg, aes(abs_GRACE_trend, dominance_R,
                            fill = regime_factor)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = boundary, xmax = Inf,
            ymin = y_lo, ymax = R_thresh,
            fill = regime_cols[["A: policy-grade"]], alpha = 0.05) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = boundary, xmax = Inf,
            ymin = R_thresh, ymax = y_hi,
            fill = regime_cols[["C: magnitude unresolved"]], alpha = 0.05) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = boundary, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4,
              colour = "grey30") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = R_thresh, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35,
              colour = "grey35") +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2.6, colour = "grey20", stroke = 0.3,
              alpha = 0.92) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = label_set,
    aes(label = short_lab),
    size = 2.1, label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.08, "cm"),
    fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.78), colour = "grey15",
    segment.size = 0.25, segment.colour = "grey45",
    min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.4, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = regime_cols, drop = TRUE,
                      breaks = regime_levels[1:4]) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  labs(x = expression(paste("|recipe-median trend|  (cm yr"^-1, " EWH, log)")),
        y = expression(paste("dominance R = IQR / |median|  (log)"))) +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.02, 0.02),
        legend.justification = c(0, 0),
        legend.background = element_rect(
          fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.78), colour = NA),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.34, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6.5))

p_dm

```{r policy-synthesis-table, dependson=c("aquifer-regimes","policy-uptake-stats","literature-stats"), cache.extra=file.mtime(here::here("datasets","bibliometric","bibliometric_master_all.csv"))}

# REGIONAL POLICY UPTAKE x SIGN-FLIP RISK #####################################
# Per region: policy_uptake = sum of flagship policy-document citations;
# sign_flip_risk = median Tier-1 minority-sign share.

# Policy uptake per region (full corpus) --------------------------------------
# pol_reg = policy_fullcorpus_by_region.csv; a paper serving several regions
# is counted in each, so per-region citations sum above the total.
policy_by_region <- data.table::copy(pol_reg)[, .(
  region,
  policy_uptake = n_policy_citations,
  n_flagships   = n_policy_cited_papers,
  n_cited       = n_policy_cited_papers
)]

# In-cohort own-SHM paper count per region (for the corpus flow in panel a) --
master_bib <- data.table::fread(
  here::here("datasets", "bibliometric", "bibliometric_master_all.csv"))
own_shm_by_region <- master_bib[
  in_cohort == TRUE & grace_role == "processes-L2-SHM",
  .(n_own_shm = .N), by = region]

# Regional sign-flip risk: median over Tier-1 aquifers in the region of the
# minority-sign share.
region_norm <- c(
  "IGP"         = "igp",
  "High Plains" = "high_plains",
  "Indus"       = "indus",
  "Guarani"     = "guarani",
  "Murray"      = "murray",
  "Arabian"     = "arabian",
  "Mississippi" = "mississippi")
aq_to_region_norm <- data.table::copy(aq_to_region)
aq_to_region_norm[, region := region_norm[region]]

risk_by_region <- merge(
  aq_reg[, .(Study_area, sign_flip = 1 - sign_agree)],
  aq_to_region_norm[, .(Study_area, region)],
  by = "Study_area")
risk_by_region <- risk_by_region[, .(
  sign_flip_risk    = stats::median(sign_flip, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_tier1_aquifers  = .N
), by = region]

# Master regional table (full outer join: regions appear if any of policy
# uptake / Tier-1 aquifers / own-SHM papers > 0).
region_table <- merge(policy_by_region,
                      risk_by_region,
                      by = "region", all = TRUE)
region_table <- merge(region_table,
                      own_shm_by_region,
                      by = "region", all.x = TRUE)
for (col in c("policy_uptake", "n_flagships", "n_cited",
              "n_tier1_aquifers", "n_own_shm")) {
  region_table[is.na(get(col)), (col) := 0L]
}
# Keep only regions with any signal in either stream.
region_table <- region_table[policy_uptake > 0 | n_tier1_aquifers > 0]

region_table[, region_label := c(
  "igp"               = "IGP",
  "central_valley"    = "Central Valley",
  "mississippi"       = "Mississippi",
  "high_plains"       = "High Plains",
  "arabian"           = "Arabian",
  "indus"             = "Indus",
  "murray"            = "Murray",
  "guarani"           = "Guarani",
  "north_china_plain" = "North China Plain",
  "murray-darling"    = "Murray-Darling"
)[region]]
region_table[is.na(region_label), region_label := region]

cat("\n=== Regional policy uptake x sign-flip risk ===\n")
data.table::setorder(region_table, -policy_uptake)
print(region_table)

# Corpus-flow counts for panel (a) -------------------------------------------
# The funnel keeps the flagship narrative (top-5 / region); the full-corpus
# uptake (33 papers, 160 citations) is shown per-region in panel (b).
n_corpus    <- nrow(master_bib)                                    # 404
n_incohort  <- nrow(master_bib[in_cohort == TRUE])                 # 278
n_ownshm    <- nrow(master_bib[in_cohort == TRUE &
                                grace_role == "processes-L2-SHM"]) # 79
n_flagships <- sum(pol$flagship == 1, na.rm = TRUE)                # 39 unique (top-5/region; Voss seed-corrected into Arabian, displaces Othman 2018)
n_polcited  <- sum(pol$flagship == 1 & pol$n_policy_documents > 0,
                   na.rm = TRUE)                                   # flagship papers cited (18)
cat(sprintf("\nCorpus funnel: %d records -> %d in-cohort -> %d own-SHM -> %d flagships -> %d flagship policy-cited\n",
            n_corpus, n_incohort, n_ownshm, n_flagships, n_polcited))

# The control Earth

This section draws the control-Earth figures from the banked outputs in
`control_earth/datasets/output/` and asserts the headline numbers from the same
tables.

```{r ce-load, cache.extra=file.mtime(list.files(here::here("control_earth","datasets","output"), recursive=TRUE, full.names=TRUE))}

# CONTROL EARTH BANKED OUTPUTS ################################################
ce_dir <- here::here("control_earth", "datasets", "output")
ce_gate  <- data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir, "calibration_report.csv"))
ce_floor <- data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir, "parametric_floor_v3.csv"))
ce_score <- data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir, "score_graded_floor_v3.csv"))
ce_planets <- list(
  pilot  = data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir, "score_pilot_uniform_depletion_v2.csv")),
  graded2 = data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir, "score_graded_floor_v2.csv")),
  graded3 = ce_score)
ce_roll  <- data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir, "rolling_null", "rolling_null_summary.csv"))
ce_vvmc  <- data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir, "val_of_val", "val_of_val_mc_numeric.csv"))
ce_vvaq  <- data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir, "val_of_val",
                                        "val_of_val_aquifer_graded_floor_v3.csv"))
ce_skill <- data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir, "recipe_skill",
                                        "per_recipe_skill_graded_floor_v3.csv"))
ce_split <- data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir, "recipe_skill",
                                        "split_half_replication.csv"))
ce_gws <- data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir, "score_gws_crossed_era5_v1.csv"))
ce_gwk <- data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir,
                                      "truth_gw_aux_trends_crossed_era5_v1.csv"))
ce_rcv <- data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir, "recipe_skill",
                                      "repeated_cv_summary.csv"))

## Sign-balanced planets (amendment 01, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21819495) ----------

ce_bal   <- data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir, "balanced_layouts_summary.csv"))
ce_bbins <- data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir, "balanced_layouts_bins.csv"))
ce_bflr  <- data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir, "balanced_layouts_floors.csv"))
ce_intl  <- data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir, "sign_interleaving.csv"))
ce_aux   <- data.table::fread(file.path(ce_dir, "aux_subtraction_balanced.csv"))
bal3 <- c("graded_balanced_v1", "graded_balanced_v2", "graded_balanced_v3")

## Boundary on the three original planets, by the same estimator as the real
## Earth. Computed once here; used by the figure and by the assertions.

ce_bnd <- vapply(ce_planets, function(d) {
  d <- data.table::copy(d)[, `:=`(abs_med = abs(median_rec),
                                  R = (q75 - q25) / abs(median_rec))]
  as.numeric(detectability_boundary_fun(d$abs_med, d$R, seed = 71,
                                        n_boot = 2000)$est)
}, numeric(1))
ce_gate

band; recovery and attenuation against sign interleaving; groundwater

```{r ce-fig4, dependson="ce-load", fig.width=5.2, fig.height=3.35}

# MS FIG. 4 -- CONTROL EARTH ##################################################

# Panel a: boundary per planet ------------------------------------------------

b_real_ce <- c(est = 0.347, lo = 0.286, hi = 0.423)
lab_bal <- c(graded_balanced_v1 = "Balanced signs 1",
             graded_balanced_v2 = "Balanced signs 2",
             graded_balanced_v3 = "Balanced signs 3")
ovl <- data.table::rbindlist(list(
  data.table::data.table(planet = "Real Earth", est = b_real_ce[["est"]],
                         lo = b_real_ce[["lo"]], hi = b_real_ce[["hi"]]),
  data.table::data.table(planet = "Uniform depletion", est = ce_bnd[["pilot"]],
                         lo = 0.263, hi = 0.408),
  data.table::data.table(planet = "Mixed signs", est = ce_bnd[["graded2"]],
                         lo = 0.270, hi = 0.685),
  data.table::data.table(planet = "Graded magnitudes", est = ce_bnd[["graded3"]],
                         lo = 0.254, hi = 0.342),
  ce_bal[planet %in% names(lab_bal),
         .(planet = lab_bal[planet], est = boundary,
           lo = boundary_lo, hi = boundary_hi)]))
ovl[, real := planet == "Real Earth"]
row_order <- c("Real Earth", "Uniform depletion", "Mixed signs",
               "Graded magnitudes", "Balanced signs 1", "Balanced signs 2",
               "Balanced signs 3")
stopifnot(setequal(row_order, ovl$planet))
ovl[, planet := factor(planet, levels = rev(row_order))]

p_bnd <- ggplot2::ggplot(ovl, ggplot2::aes(x = est, y = planet, color = real)) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = b_real_ce[["est"]], linetype = "dotted",
                      linewidth = 0.3, color = "#0072B2") +
  ggplot2::geom_pointrange(ggplot2::aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), linewidth = 0.4,
                           size = 0.28, na.rm = TRUE) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#0072B2",
                                         "FALSE" = "grey30"), guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.75), breaks = c(0, 0.35, 0.7)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = bquote("cm" ~ yr^-1), y = NULL) +
  theme_AP() + ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(2, 4, 2, 2))
nx <- ovl[is.na(est), planet]
if (length(nx))
  p_bnd <- p_bnd +
    ggplot2::geom_text(data = data.table::data.table(planet = nx, est = 0.02),
                       ggplot2::aes(x = est, y = planet), label = "no crossing",
                       hjust = 0, size = 2.1, color = "grey30",
                       fontface = "italic", inherit.aes = FALSE)

# Panel b: sign recovery by magnitude band ------------------------------------

# ASCII bin labels: the PDF device drops a literal "<=" glyph.
bd <- ce_bbins[planet %in% c("graded_floor_v3", bal3)]
bd[, bin := factor(bin, levels = c("<=0.25", "0.25-0.5", "0.5-0.75",
                                   "0.75-1", ">1"),
                   labels = c("0-0.25", "0.25-0.5", "0.5-0.75",
                              "0.75-1", ">1"))]
bmed <- bd[planet %in% bal3, .(median_p_sign = median(median_p_sign)), by = bin]

p_bin <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0.9, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.25,
                      color = "grey60") +
  ggplot2::geom_line(data = bd[planet %in% bal3],
                     ggplot2::aes(x = bin, y = median_p_sign, group = planet),
                     color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.25) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(data = bmed,
                     ggplot2::aes(x = bin, y = median_p_sign, group = 1,
                                  color = "Balanced signs"), linewidth = 0.5) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = bmed,
                      ggplot2::aes(x = bin, y = median_p_sign,
                                   color = "Balanced signs"), size = 1.2) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(data = bd[planet == "graded_floor_v3"],
                     ggplot2::aes(x = bin, y = median_p_sign, group = 1,
                                  color = "Graded magnitudes"), linewidth = 0.5) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = bd[planet == "graded_floor_v3"],
                      ggplot2::aes(x = bin, y = median_p_sign,
                                   color = "Graded magnitudes"), size = 1.2) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("Graded magnitudes" = "#D55E00",
                                         "Balanced signs" = "grey15"),
                              name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.3, 1)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = bquote("True trend magnitude (cm" ~ yr^-1 * ")"),
                y = "P(correct sign)") +
  theme_AP() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = c(0.97, 0.03),
                 legend.justification = c(1, 0),
                 axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5.4, angle = 30,
                                                     hjust = 1),
                 plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(2, 4, 2, 7))

# Panel c: recovery and attenuation against sign interleaving -----------------

# The sign-imbalanced planet sits at zero interleaving: all its planted signs
# are negative, so no aquifer has an opposite-signed neighbour.
pc_ids <- c("graded_floor_v3", bal3)
pc <- merge(ce_bal[planet %in% pc_ids, .(planet, median_p_sign, attenuation)],
            ce_intl[, .(planet, n_within_500km)], by = "planet")
pc <- data.table::melt(pc, id.vars = c("planet", "n_within_500km"),
                       measure.vars = c("median_p_sign", "attenuation"),
                       variable.name = "metric", value.name = "value")
pc[, metric := factor(metric, levels = c("median_p_sign", "attenuation"),
                      labels = c("Sign recovery", "Recovered / true"))]

p_int <- ggplot2::ggplot(pc, ggplot2::aes(x = n_within_500km, y = value,
                                          color = metric, shape = metric)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) + ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.4) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("Sign recovery" = "grey15",
                                         "Recovered / true" = "#0072B2"),
                              name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17), name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, by = 25)) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Number of aquifers with opposite-signed\nneighbour (< 500 km)",
                y = "Fraction") +
  theme_AP() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = c(0.97, 0.03),
                 legend.justification = c(1, 0),
                 plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(2, 4, 2, 2))

# Panel d: groundwater subtraction -------------------------------------------

pd_aux <- ce_aux[, .(n_ok = sum(median_sign_ok)), by = .(planet, estimator)]
pd_aux[, layout := factor(planet, levels = bal3, labels = c("1", "2", "3"))]
pd_aux[, estimator := factor(estimator, levels = c("gldas", "none", "era5"),
                             labels = c("Matched (GLDAS-Noah)", "No correction",
                                        "Mismatched (ERA5-Land)"))]

p_aux <- ggplot2::ggplot(pd_aux, ggplot2::aes(x = layout, y = n_ok,
                                              color = estimator,
                                              shape = estimator,
                                              group = estimator)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) + ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.4) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("Matched (GLDAS-Noah)" = "#0072B2",
                                         "No correction" = "grey55",
                                         "Mismatched (ERA5-Land)" = "#D55E00"),
                              name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 15, 17), name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(38, 82), breaks = c(40, 50, 60, 70)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Balanced planet", y = "Signs recovered") +
  theme_AP() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = c(0.99, 0.99),
                 legend.justification = c(1, 1),
                 plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(2, 4, 2, 7))

cowplot::plot_grid(p_bnd, p_bin, p_int, p_aux, ncol = 2L,
                   rel_widths = c(0.5, 0.5), rel_heights = c(0.5, 0.5),
                   labels = "auto")

**SM Fig. S14.** Validation of the well validation: GRACE-well sign agreement
above and below the boundary against the assumed specific yield, and the error
decomposition on the graded planet.

```{r ce-sm-figs, dependson="ce-load", fig.width=5.5, fig.height=2.9}

# SM FIG. S14 -- VALIDATION OF THE WELL VALIDATION ############################

pd_a <- ce_vvmc[metric %in% c("agree_above_pct", "agree_below_pct")]
pd_a[, side := data.table::fifelse(metric == "agree_above_pct",
                                   "above boundary", "below boundary")]
pd_a[, planet_lab := factor(planet,
  levels = c("pilot_uniform_depletion_v2", "graded_floor_v2",
             "graded_floor_v3"),
  labels = c("Uniform depletion", "Mixed signs", "Graded magnitudes"))]

p_agree <- ggplot2::ggplot(pd_a, ggplot2::aes(x = factor(sy), y = mean,
                                              color = side)) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 68, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3,
                      color = "#0072B2") +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 51, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3,
                      color = "#D55E00") +
  ggplot2::geom_pointrange(ggplot2::aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), size = 0.25,
                           linewidth = 0.4,
                           position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.45)) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~planet_lab) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("above boundary" = "#0072B2",
                                         "below boundary" = "#D55E00"),
                              name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Assumed specific yield",
                y = "GRACE-well sign agreement (%)") +
  theme_AP() + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "top")

pd_b <- ce_vvmc[planet == "graded_floor_v3" &
                metric %in% c("false_valid_pct", "missed_valid_pct",
                              "well_wrong_pct")]
pd_b[, metric_lab := factor(metric,
  levels = c("missed_valid_pct", "well_wrong_pct", "false_valid_pct"),
  labels = c("GRACE right when\nwells disagree",
             "well aggregate wrong\non true sign",
             "GRACE wrong when\nwells agree"))]

p_err <- ggplot2::ggplot(pd_b, ggplot2::aes(x = factor(sy), y = mean,
                                            color = metric_lab)) +
  ggplot2::geom_pointrange(ggplot2::aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), size = 0.25,
                           linewidth = 0.4,
                           position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.45)) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("#6a3d9a", "#e31a1c", "#33a02c"),
                              name = NULL,
                              guide = ggplot2::guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Assumed specific yield", y = "Rate (%)") +
  theme_AP() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left")

cowplot::plot_grid(p_agree, p_err, ncol = 2L, rel_widths = c(0.62, 0.38),
                   labels = "auto")
```
